definition_zh: 拖车；挂车；拖斗；房车；预告片
definition_en: a vehicle or container without an engine that is pulled behind another vehicle, or a short piece of film advertising a longer one
core_image: 一辆小货车后面挂着一只没有轮子驱动的铁箱，跟着前车在路上走
scene: 电影开场前的十分钟里，银幕上连放了三个新片预告。The audience hushed as the first trailer flickered onto the screen.
sceneCN: 这里 trailer 是「预告片」（第 4 个义项：正片前放映的短片）；句意为第一部预告片在银幕上闪起时，观众安静了下来。画面里是昏暗的影院与发亮的银幕。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成名词所依附的基础词，义为「拖；拉；尾随」
由动词加 -ing 构成形容词，义为「拖着的；后面的」
由名词加 -ful 构成，义为「一拖车的量」

senses.title: A container pulled behind a vehicle
senses.definition: an unpowered container or platform that is towed by a car, van, or lorry
senses.definitionCN: 由汽车、货车牵引、自身没有动力的箱体或平台
senses.example: They loaded the furniture onto a trailer and drove north.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把家具装上拖车，向北开去。
senses.why: The word is simply trail plus the agent suffix -er, so the thing is named for what it does: it trails behind.
senses.whyCN: 这个词只是 trail 加施事后缀 -er，器物按它的动作命名——它总是跟在后面拖行。

senses.title: A home that can be towed
senses.definition: a large trailer fitted out with beds and a kitchen for living in
senses.definitionCN: 装有床铺和厨房、可供居住的大型拖车
senses.example: For two summers the family lived in a trailer beside the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 有两个夏天，这家人就住在湖边的住宿拖车里。
senses.why: Once a trailer carries people rather than goods, it becomes a movable house, and the same noun covers it.
senses.whyCN: 当拖车装的是人而不是货物，它就成了可以移动的房子，同一个名词就兼指两者。

senses.title: Something that follows in a line
senses.definition: a part attached to the back of something and moving along with it
senses.definitionCN: 附着在别物后面随之移动的部分
senses.example: The last trailer of the wedding convoy was still lost in the village.
senses.exampleCN: 婚礼车队最后那一节还困在村里没出来。
senses.why: This is the oldest layer of the image: anything that hangs on behind and follows is a trailer.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心意象最古老的一层：任何挂在后面跟着走的东西都叫 trailer。

senses.title: A short piece of film advertising a longer one
senses.definition: a brief extract shown before a feature film to advertise it
senses.definitionCN: 正片之前放映、用于宣传正片的短片
senses.example: The trailer gave away the ending, which annoyed everyone who saw it.
senses.exampleCN: 预告片把结局泄露了，让看过的人都恼火。
senses.why: A trailer once trailed behind the main attraction at a cinema; later it was moved to the front but kept the name.
senses.whyCN: 早期这类短片确实排在影院正片之后，后来虽移到前面放映，名字却没改。

senses.title: A goods vehicle without an engine
senses.definition: the cargo section of a lorry, separable from the cab that pulls it
senses.definitionCN: 货车上与牵引车头可分离的载货部分
senses.example: The driver unhooked the trailer at the depot and took a new one.
senses.exampleCN: 司机在货站摘下挂车，换上了一辆新的。
senses.why: The unpowered cargo half of a lorry is nothing but a trailing box, so the old literal sense still holds.
senses.whyCN: 货车后面那个没有动力的货箱就是一只被拖着的箱子，古老的字面义依然成立。

senses.title: The last part of a news broadcast
senses.definition: a final item at the end of a programme, especially a light one
senses.definitionCN: 节目结尾的一个条目，通常是轻松的那一个
senses.example: The news ended with a trailer about the village fair.
senses.exampleCN: 新闻以一条关于村集市的尾声报道结束。
senses.why: Borrowed from the cinema sense, this use treats the closing item as something tagging along behind the main news.
senses.whyCN: 这个用法借自电影义项，把收尾条目看作跟在主体新闻后面的东西。

intro.en: Trailer is an English coinage on the verb trail, from Old French traillier, to drag, which goes back to Latin trahere, to pull.
intro.cn: trailer 是由动词 trail 派生的英语自造词，trail 来自古法语 traillier（拖），再上溯到拉丁语 trahere（拉）。

items.en: Trahere means to draw or pull, and its stem gives English many words of drawing and dragging.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉、牵引，其词干在英语中衍生出许多表示拉拽的词。

items.en: Old French traillier means to drag along the ground or to follow in someone's track.
items.cn: 古法语 traillier 意为沿地面拖行，或跟在某人的足迹之后。

items.en: English takes the verb trail for dragging and for following, and the noun trail for a dragged path.
items.cn: 英语借入动词 trail，表示拖行与跟踪，名词 trail 则指被拖出的路径。

items.en: The nineteenth century forms trailer as the name for a thing towed behind another, at first of a wagon attachment.
items.cn: 十九世纪出现 trailer，用来称呼被别的车拖着走的东西，最初指马车的附加车厢。

items.en: With the motor car the sense widens to caravan and cargo trailer, and with the cinema it shifts to the advertising short.
items.cn: 随着汽车普及，词义扩展到房车与载货挂车；随着电影出现，又转为指宣传短片。

note.en: The look-alike group collects forms built on trail and near-spellings in lorry jargon, while the near-meaning group gathers other towed or moving-home words.
note.cn: 形近组收集由 trail 构成的形式以及货车行话中的近似拼法，近义组汇集其他被牵引的、可移动居住的词语。

entries.definition: to drag along, or a path through rough country
to fish with a large net dragged behind a boat
entries.definitionCN: 拖网捕鱼；只是拼写与发音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a boat that fishes with a dragged net
entries.definitionCN: 拖网渔船；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a small wheeled cart pushed by hand
entries.definitionCN: 手推车；只是拼写与发音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a large road vehicle for carrying goods
a vehicle for carrying loads, usually four-wheeled
a vehicle towed behind a car for living in on holiday
a showing of a film before it opens generally

normalIntro.en: The group of forms built on trail gives several hooks: the verb, the -er thing, and the -ing shape.
normalIntro.cn: 由 trail 构成的一组形式提供几个抓手：动词、加 -er 的器物、加 -ing 的形态。

normal.en: Trail plus -er means the thing that trails, which is exactly a towed box.
normal.cn: trail 加 -er 就是「拖行的那个东西」，正是被牵引的箱子。

normal.en: The same -er that turns teach into teacher turns trail into trailer.
normal.cn: 让 teach 变成 teacher 的那个 -er，也让 trail 变成 trailer。

normal.en: In lorry work the cab pulls and the trailer is pulled, so the word marks the passive half.
normal.cn: 在货运里，车头负责拉、挂车被拉，这个词标记的正是被动的那一半。

normal.en: A trailer for a film trails the story in miniature ahead of the full version.
normal.cn: 电影预告片把故事浓缩成小样，先于完整版出现。

normal.en: The caravan sense follows because a trailer can carry beds as easily as bricks.
normal.cn: 房车义项顺理成章，因为拖车既能装砖，也能铺床。

abstract.en: Picture a small iron box leaping behind a car, its wheels spinning with no engine of their own.
abstract.cn: 想象一只铁皮箱在汽车后面颠着走，轮子转得飞快却自己没有发动机。

abstract.en: Hear the bump as it crosses a pothole, a sound that no engine can make.
abstract.cn: 听它压过坑洼时的那一声闷响，那是发动机发不出的声音。

abstract.en: Then shrink the whole trailer into a ten-second screen of flickering images.
abstract.cn: 再把整辆拖车缩成十秒钟跳动的小画面。

examples.en: He hooked the trailer to the back of the van before dawn.
examples.cn: 天亮前他把拖车挂到了货车后面。

examples.en: The trailer for the new film ran twice before the main feature.
examples.cn: 新片的预告片在正片之前放了两遍。

examples.en: Trailers heavier than a set weight need a special licence.
examples.cn: 超过规定重量的挂车需要特殊驾照。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹了」——车头一开，后面的箱子被吹着走，就是拖车。

root: 英语动词 trail（拖；拉）加施事后缀 -er；trail 来自古法语 traillier，源自拉丁语 trahere（拉；牵引）

sensesIntro.en: All senses keep the same picture, something hanging on behind and moving with a puller, from cargo box to caravan to the short film that follows the feature.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项共享同一幅画面：挂在后面、被牵着走的东西，从货箱到房车，再到跟在正片后面的短片。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an engineless box towed along behind a pulling vehicle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只没有动力、被前车拖着走的箱子。

branches.en: The literal family: the towed box, the part that follows, and the lorry's cargo half.
branches.cn: 字面一族：被拖的箱子、跟随的部分、货车的载货半截。

branches.en: The dwelling sense, where a trailer carries people instead of goods.
branches.cn: 居住义：拖车装的是人而不是货物。

branches.en: The cinema sense, where the trailing short became an opening advertisement.
branches.cn: 电影义：跟在后面的短片变成了开场广告。

branches.en: The broadcast sense, where the closing item tags along after the news.
branches.cn: 广播义：收尾条目跟在新闻之后。

branches.en: Both senses move the word from transport to culture, keeping the image of something towed.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把这个词从运输带进文化领域，而「被牵引」的画面始终不变。

intro.en: The word is a plain English derivative, so its affix story is the agent suffix -er on a verb.
intro.cn: 这是个普通的英语派生词，词缀故事就是动词后加施事后缀 -er。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source trahere supplies the stem, while -er is native English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 提供词干，而 -er 是英语本族后缀。

items.example: Trail gives trailer as teach gives teacher.
items.exampleCN: trail 生 trailer，正如 teach 生 teacher。

items.example: The scarf trailed in the mud.
items.exampleCN: 围巾在泥里拖着。

items.example: She wore a trailing gown.
items.exampleCN: 她穿了一件拖地长裙。

items.meaning: one that does or is something
items.meaningCN: 做某事或充当某物的人或物
items.example: A cooker cooks, and a trailer trails.
items.exampleCN: cooker 用来煮，trailer 用来拖。

items.meaning: the start of a walking path
items.example: We met at the trailhead at six.
items.exampleCN: 我们六点在步道起点碰头。

items.meaning: a pioneer who marks a new path
items.example: She was a trailblazer for women in science.
items.exampleCN: 她是科学界女性的开路先锋。

items.example: This boat is trailerable behind a small car.
items.exampleCN: 这条船能用小汽车拖运。

items.meaning: a site where trailers are parked as homes
items.example: They bought a plot in a trailer park.
items.exampleCN: 他们在拖车营地里买了一块地。

definition_zh: 特征；特质；性状；一点、一丝（某性质）；一笔（旧义）
definition_en: a distinguishing quality of a person, group or living thing, or a slight amount of something
core_image: 一张脸上只用一笔勾出的那道线，远看是轮廓，近看才知道是标记
scene: 同窝的幼犬里，只有一只从头到尾都不往人跟前凑，训导员在记录表上给它画了一道。That single trait decided which puppy went to the quiet household.
sceneCN: 这里 trait 指「一个可辨认、相对稳定的特征」（第 1 个义项：性格或性状上的特征）；句意是这一个特征决定了哪只幼犬被送去安静的人家。图中可辨识物件：记录表上的一道笔划、蜷在角落的幼犬、伸手的训导员。

derivatives.zh: 特征（复数）
特性 / 典型的
属性 / 把……归于
特质理论

senses.title: A distinguishing quality
senses.titleCN: 一个可辨认的区别性品质
senses.definition: a stable quality that marks a person out from others
senses.definitionCN: 使人区别于他人的一项稳定品质
senses.example: That single trait decided which puppy went to the quiet household.
senses.exampleCN: 这一个特征决定了哪只幼犬被送去安静的人家。
senses.why: the word began as a drawn line, and a line is exactly what marks one thing off from another.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指画出的一条线，而线正是把一物与另一物分开的标记。

senses.title: A feature of a thing
senses.definition: a noticeable property of an object, system or style
senses.definitionCN: 物体、制度或风格上明显可见的一项属性
senses.example: The script's most useful trait is that it can be read upside down.
senses.exampleCN: 这种文字最有用的一点是倒着也能读。
senses.why: the line can be drawn on anything, so the word easily leaves people and attaches to objects.
senses.whyCN: 线可以画在任何东西上，因此这个词很容易离开人，附到物上。

senses.title: A slight amount
senses.definition: a small trace of a quality, in older or literary usage
senses.definitionCN: 某种性质的一点点痕迹，属较旧或文学化的用法
senses.example: There was a trait of irony in the old man's courtesy.
senses.exampleCN: 老人的礼貌里带一丝讥讽。
senses.why: a single drawn stroke is also the smallest visible amount, which is how the word came to mean a trace.
senses.whyCN: 单独画出的一笔也是最小的可见量，这个词由此有了「一丝」的意思。

senses.title: A biological character
senses.definition: an inherited characteristic of an organism, such as eye colour
senses.definitionCN: 生物体遗传而来的特征，如眼睛颜色
senses.example: Sickle cell is a trait that protects against one kind of malaria.
senses.exampleCN: 镰状细胞是一种能抵抗某类疟疾的性状。
senses.why: genetics needed a countable unit and borrowed the same word, keeping the idea of a marked feature.
senses.whyCN: 遗传学需要一个可计数的单位，借用了同一个词，保留了「被标出的特征」这一观念。

senses.title: A recurring way of acting
senses.definition: a habit of behaviour treated as evidence of something deeper
senses.definitionCN: 被当作更深层之证据的行为习惯
senses.example: Interrupting is a trait his colleagues have learned to expect.
senses.exampleCN: 打断别人是他同事已学会预期的一个特点。
senses.why: one act is an event, but repetition turns it into a trait, which is why observers wait before naming one.
senses.whyCN: 一次行为是一个事件，重复才把它变成特质，因此观察者会等一等再命名。

senses.title: Something a group shares
senses.definition: a feature common to a culture, generation or kind
senses.definitionCN: 文化、世代或类别中共同具有的特征
senses.example: Suspicion of strangers is a trait of the region rather than of the family.
senses.exampleCN: 对外人的戒心是这个地区的特征，而不是这一家的。
senses.why: the same mark can be drawn around many people at once, which lets the word describe a collective.
senses.whyCN: 同一个标记可以一次画在一群人周围，这就让这个词能描述集体。

senses.title: A stroke of the pen
senses.definition: the original sense: a single line drawn by hand
senses.definitionCN: 本义：手画出的一条线
senses.example: The mapmaker added one trait and the border changed.
senses.exampleCN: 绘图者添了一笔，边界就变了。
senses.why: this is the literal sense from which all the others radiate, and it survives in careful historical writing.
senses.whyCN: 这是所有其他义项由之辐射的字面义，在严谨的历史写作中仍然存留。

senses.title: A line of the face
senses.definition: in literary description, a feature of the face or outline
senses.definitionCN: 在文学描写中指面部或轮廓上的一道线
senses.example: The portrait catches one trait of the mouth and nothing else.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅肖像只抓住了嘴部的一道线，别的都没有。
senses.why: a face is read line by line, so the oldest drawing sense survives most naturally in portraits.
senses.whyCN: 脸是一道道线读出来的，因此最古老的「划线」义在肖像描写里保存得最自然。

intro.en: Trait comes from French trait, from Latin tractus 'a drawing, a line, a pull', from trahere 'to draw, drag'. English borrowed it in the sixteenth century; the psychological sense is much later. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: trait 来自法语 trait，上溯拉丁 tractus「划线、牵引」，出自 trahere「拉、拖」。英语在 16 世纪借入，心理学义则晚得多。年代均为约数。

items.en: Trahere meant 'to draw, drag, pull'. It is the source of tractor, traction, attract and contract, and its deeper origin is not established.
items.cn: trahere 意为「拉、拖、牵引」。它是 tractor、traction、attract、contract 的来源，更深来源未得到证明。

items.en: The noun meant 'a drawing, a line, a course, a pull'. The sense of a line drawn by the hand is the seed of the later meanings.
items.cn: 这个名词意为「划线、路线、牵引」。手画出的一条线这一义，是后来各义的种子。

items.en: French trait kept the sense of a stroke or line and extended it to a feature of the face and then of character.
items.cn: 法语 trait 保留了「一笔、一线」的意思，并把它延伸到面部特征，再延伸到性格特征。

items.en: English took the word in the sixteenth century, first for a stroke of the pen and soon for a feature of body or mind.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪借入这个词，先指一笔，很快指身体或心智上的一个特征。

items.en: Nineteenth- and twentieth-century psychology and genetics made trait a countable unit, so that people and organisms could be described feature by feature.
items.cn: 19 与 20 世纪的心理学与遗传学把 trait 变成可计数的单位，人与生物于是可以一条条特征来描述。

items.en: Source uncertain: the pre-Latin origin of trahere remains a reconstruction, and the first English use for character is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定：trahere 在拉丁语之前的来源属重构形式，英语中首次用于「性格特征」义的年代也未精确。

note.en: Group one holds look-alikes that belong to different histories; group two holds the near synonyms with different weight.
note.cn: 第一组是字形相近却来历不同的词；第二组是分量不同的近义词。

entries.definition: From Latin tradere 'to hand over' through French: a person who hands others over. It shares no root with this word despite the spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 经法语出自拉丁 tradere「交出」：指把别人交出去的人。尽管拼写相近，与本词不同源。

entries.definition: Same Latin noun, but English kept it for a stretch of land or a short pamphlet, a drawn-out area rather than a line.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个拉丁名词，但英语把它留作一片土地或一本小册子，指拉展开的区域而非一条线。

entries.definition: From the same verb of drawing: the mark left behind, which overlaps with the sense of a slight amount.
entries.definitionCN: 同出那个「拉、画」的动词：留下的痕迹，与「一丝」义重叠。

entries.definition: From the same verb through French: something drawn along in a line, later a line of carriages.
entries.definitionCN: 经法语同出那个动词：被拉成一列的东西，后指一列车厢。

entries.definition: A feature that typifies a group or thing; it is broader and less technical than trait.
entries.definitionCN: 使一个群体或事物显出典型性的特征；比 trait 更宽、更少专业味。

entries.definition: A quality ascribed to someone or something, often from outside; traits are meant to be internal and stable.
entries.definitionCN: 被归到某人某物名下的品质，常由外界赋予；特质则被设定为内在而稳定。

entries.definition: The ordinary word for any feature, without the claim of stability that trait carries.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何特征的普通词，不带 trait 那种稳定性的主张。

entries.definition: A behaviour repeated until it is automatic; it can be changed, while a trait is presented as part of the make-up.
entries.definitionCN: 重复到自动化的行为；习惯可以改，而特质被呈现为构成的一部分。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root verb means 'to draw', so a trait is literally a line drawn to mark something.
normal.cn: 词根动词意为「拉、画」，因此 trait 字面上就是为标记某物而画的一条线。

normal.en: The family runs trait, traits, trait theory, personality trait, character trait.
normal.cn: 同族说法包括 trait、traits、trait theory、personality trait、character trait。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: a genetic trait, a personality trait, a common trait.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：遗传性状、人格特质、共同特征。

normal.en: The same Latin noun also gave tract, trace and train, each keeping a different part of the image.
normal.cn: 同一个拉丁名词还给了 tract、trace、train，各保留了意象的不同部分。

normal.en: Genetics says dominant and recessive traits, which shows the countable unit clearly.
normal.cn: 遗传学说显性与隐性性状，这把可计数单位记得很清。

abstract.en: Picture a single pencil line on a face, enough to make it recognisable.
abstract.cn: 想象脸上一道铅笔线，就足以让人认出。

abstract.en: Picture a map where one added stroke redraws a border.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上添的一笔改变了边界。

abstract.en: Picture a thread pulled out of cloth that still carries the shape of the weave.
abstract.cn: 想象从布里抽出的一根线，仍带着织法的形状。

examples.en: Patience is the one trait the job actually requires.
examples.cn: 这份工作真正要求的唯一特质是耐心。

examples.en: The species shares a trait that lets it survive dry seasons.
examples.cn: 这个物种共有一种能让它熬过旱季的性状。

examples.en: There was not a trait of irony in her reply.
examples.cn: 她的回答里没有一丝讥讽。

dict_mnemonic.text: trait 读如「垂特」——特意垂下的一笔 → 特征、特质

root: 法语 trait，上溯拉丁 tractus「划线、牵引」，出自 trahere「拉、拖」；与表「背叛者」的词形近而不同源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one movement: a line is drawn by hand, and that line is then read as a distinguishing quality, as a property of things, as a slight trace, as a biological character, as repeated behaviour, as a group's mark and finally as a line of the face.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个动作展开：手画出一条线，这条线依次被读作区别性品质、事物的属性、一丝痕迹、生物性状、重复行为、群体的标记，最后是脸上的一道线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one pencil line drawn across a face, far off a mere outline, close up a deliberate mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：脸上画出的一道铅笔线，远看只是轮廓，近看才知道是刻意的标记。

branches.en: THE MARK AND ITS CARRIER: first a quality that separates people, then the same mark drawn on an object.
branches.cn: 标记与承载体：先是把人与人分开的品质，再是画在物件上的同一标记。

branches.en: THE THINNEST LINE: one stroke is also the smallest visible amount, which is how the word came to mean a trace.
branches.cn: 最细的一条线：一笔也是最小的可见量，这个词由此有了「一丝」。

branches.en: THE MARK MADE INHERITABLE: genetics borrows the unit and ties the mark to a body.
branches.cn: 标记变成可遗传之物：遗传学借走这个单位，把标记绑到身体上。

branches.en: REPETITION AND SCALE: the same mark is inferred from repeated acts, or drawn around a whole group.
branches.cn: 重复与尺度：同一标记或从重复行为推断，或被画在整个群体周围。

branches.en: BACK TO THE HAND: the literal stroke survives in maps and portraits, where the drawn line is the thing itself.
branches.cn: 回到那只手：字面的一笔活在地图与肖像里，那里画出的线就是事物本身。

intro.en: A Latin participle used as a noun, carried through French, with one family of words keeping the drawing sense and another keeping the pulling sense.
intro.cn: 一个拉丁分词被当作名词使用，经法语传来；词族里一部分保留「画线」义，另一部分保留「拉」义。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere 'to draw' gives tract, trace, train, traction and contract; the noun tractus gives the line sense that French turned into this word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 trahere「拉」衍生 tract、trace、train、traction、contract；名词 tractus 则提供「线」义，法语由此造出本词。

items.example: The verb supplies the act of drawing a line.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「画线」的动作。

items.meaning: a drawing, a line, a pull
items.example: The noun supplies the visible result.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词提供可见的结果。

items.example: Interrupting is a trait his colleagues expect.
items.exampleCN: 打断别人是他同事预期的特点。

items.example: The study rates twelve traits.
items.exampleCN: 这项研究评估十二项特征。

items.meaning: the approach that explains people by stable traits
items.meaningCN: 用稳定特质解释人的理论
items.example: Trait theory underlies the questionnaire.
items.exampleCN: 特质理论是这份问卷的基础。

items.meaning: an area or a short essay
items.example: A tract of forest was set aside.
items.exampleCN: 一片林地被划了出来。

items.example: No trace of the letter remained.
items.exampleCN: 那封信没有留下任何痕迹。

items.example: The idea is drawn out into a line.
items.exampleCN: 这个意象被拉成一条线。

latinEntries.meaning: a drawing, a line, a course

definition_zh: 交易；业务；办理；事务；和解
definition_en: an act of buying, selling, or exchanging something, or the process of doing business with someone
core_image: 两双手隔着柜台把东西推过去、把东西拉过来，一来一往
scene: 银行柜台前，柜员把存单递出来请客户签字。Every transaction over five thousand yuan must be signed by the customer.
sceneCN: 这里 transaction 是「交易、业务办理」（第 1 个义项：买卖或钱财往来）；句意为每笔五千元以上的交易都必须由客户签字。画面里有柜台、存单与签字笔。

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词后缀 -ion 还原为动词，义为「办理；进行交易」
由名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「交易的；事务性的」
由动词加 -or 构成，义为「交易者；办理人」

senses.title: An act of buying or selling
senses.definition: a single act of exchanging money for goods or services
senses.definitionCN: 一次用钱换取货物或服务的往来
senses.example: Each transaction is printed on the receipt.
senses.exampleCN: 每笔交易都打印在收据上。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to drive through or carry out, and a deal is something driven through to the end.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词本义是「推行、办成」，一笔买卖正是被一路推到完成的事。

senses.title: The handling of a piece of business
senses.definition: the doing or carrying out of a matter, especially official business
senses.definitionCN: 把一件事办完，尤指公务上的办理
senses.example: The transaction of the case took three months.
senses.exampleCN: 这个案子的办理花了三个月。
senses.why: Before it meant a deal, the word meant simply getting a matter done, and that older sense survives in formal prose.
senses.whyCN: 在表示买卖之前，这个词只表示把事办完，这个古老含义留在正式文体里。

senses.title: Dealings between people or bodies
senses.definition: the activity of doing business or exchanging views with another party
senses.definitionCN: 与另一方做生意或交换意见的活动
senses.example: The two firms kept their transactions short and formal.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司的往来简短而正式。
senses.why: A transaction is always across something, from one party to the other, which is what the prefix trans- marks.
senses.whyCN: 交易总是跨过某个界限、从一方到另一方，这正是前缀 trans- 所标记的。

senses.title: A record of money moved
senses.definition: a single entry recording money paid in or out
senses.definitionCN: 记录一笔进出款项的条目
senses.example: The bank lists every transaction from the past year.
senses.exampleCN: 银行列出了过去一年的每一笔账目。
senses.why: Once deals are written into books, the written line itself comes to be called a transaction.
senses.whyCN: 交易一旦记进账簿，那一行字本身也被称为一笔 transaction。

senses.title: A settlement between parties
senses.definition: an arrangement that settles a dispute or account between two sides
senses.definitionCN: 使双方争执或债务得以了结的安排
senses.example: The dispute ended in an amicable transaction out of court.
senses.exampleCN: 这场争执以庭外和解告终。
senses.why: If a transaction is something driven through, a dispute driven to an end is the same act applied to conflict.
senses.whyCN: 若 transaction 是把事情推到完结，那么把争执推到完结，就是同一动作用在冲突上。

senses.title: One unit of work in computing
senses.definition: a set of database operations that must all succeed or all fail together
senses.definitionCN: 一组必须全部成功或全部回退的数据库操作
senses.example: If the network drops, the transaction is rolled back.
senses.exampleCN: 如果网络中断，这笔事务就会被回退。
senses.why: Computing borrows the word for a deal because a database operation must also be carried through completely.
senses.whyCN: 计算机借用这个「买卖」词，因为数据库操作同样必须完整办成。

intro.en: The word is built on Latin trans-, across, and agere, to drive or do, so that a transaction is literally something driven through.
intro.cn: 本词由拉丁语 trans-（穿过）与 agere（推动、做）构成，字面就是「被推行到底的事」。

items.en: Agere means to drive, lead, or do, and supplies the -act- seen in many English words.
items.cn: 拉丁语 agere 意为驱赶、带领、做，提供英语许多词中的 -act- 部分。

items.en: Transigere means to drive through, to settle a matter, or to come to terms with someone.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transigere 意为推行通过、把事情了结、与人达成条件。

items.en: The noun transactio names the settling or the carrying out of a matter.
items.cn: 名词 transactio 指事情的了结或办理。

items.en: French transaction keeps the sense of a settlement or an arrangement between parties.
items.cn: 法语 transaction 保留了双方了结或达成安排的含义。

items.en: English takes the word in the fifteenth century for the doing of business, and the commercial sense of a deal grows dominant.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入该词，指办理事务，随后「一笔买卖」的商业含义逐渐占主导。

items.en: Banking and later computing give the word its modern technical life as a counted, recorded entry.
items.cn: 银行业以及后来的计算机领域，使这个词获得「可计数、可记录条目」的现代技术生命。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -act- stem and the trans- prefix, while the near-meaning group gathers words for deals, sales, and financial records.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -act- 词干与 trans- 前缀，近义组汇集表示交易、销售与财务记录的词。

entries.definition: to carry out a piece of business
a person or firm that carries out a deal
relating to dealings or exchanges
the doing of something
an agreement or a bargain between two sides
the act of giving one thing and receiving another
the act of buying something
an amount of money paid

normalIntro.en: Break the word into trans- and -act- and the meaning follows almost by itself.
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆成 trans- 与 -act-，词义几乎自己就出来了。

normal.en: Trans- means across, so every deal carries something from one side to the other.
normal.cn: trans- 表示「跨过」，每笔交易都把东西从一方带到另一方。

normal.en: The -act- part is act, the same as in action, so a transaction is an act done through.
normal.cn: 其中 -act- 就是 act，与 action 同源，所以 transaction 是一个「办到底的动作」。

normal.en: Compare agere words you already know: agent, agenda, action, all about doing.
normal.cn: 对比你已认识的 agere 词族：agent、agenda、action，都与「做」有关。

normal.en: In a bank the word is used for a single line of money moving, which is a deal in miniature.
normal.cn: 在银行里这个词指一行钱的进出，也就是一笔缩小的买卖。

normal.en: The verb transact is the same word without the noun ending, which proves the pair.
normal.cn: 动词 transact 就是去掉名词词尾的同形词，这组配对可以互相印证。

abstract.en: Picture two hands across a wooden counter, one pushing a document, the other pushing money.
abstract.cn: 想象隔着木柜台的双手，一只推出文件，一只推过钞票。

abstract.en: Feel the counter as a boundary, because the word always crosses something.
abstract.cn: 把柜台当成一道界限，因为这个词总是跨过点什么。

abstract.en: Then hear the printer spit out one line, the record of that single crossing.
abstract.cn: 再听打印机吐出一行字，记录这一次跨越。

examples.en: The transaction was completed in less than a minute.
examples.cn: 这笔交易不到一分钟就完成了。

examples.en: Keep every transaction record for at least three years.
examples.cn: 每笔交易的记录至少要保存三年。

examples.en: They agreed to settle the matter by a quiet transaction out of court.
examples.cn: 他们同意以低调的庭外和解了断此事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿再克实」——穿过去把事办扎实，就是一笔交易。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ agere（推动；做），其名词 transactio 经法语进入英语；同族有 act、action、agent

sensesIntro.en: The senses fan out from one picture, something driven across a boundary and carried to completion, whether a sale, an official matter, or a logged entry.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项从一幅画面展开：跨过界限并被办到底的事，无论是买卖、公务还是记账条目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two parties across a counter, each pushing something through to the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：隔着柜台的两方，各自把东西推到对方手里。

branches.en: The commercial family: a sale, and the ongoing dealings between two parties.
branches.cn: 商业一族：一次买卖，以及两方之间的持续往来。

branches.en: The procedural sense, where the word still means simply finishing a piece of business.
branches.cn: 程序义：这个词仍只表示把一件事办完。

branches.en: The bookkeeping sense, where the written line takes the name of the act.
branches.cn: 记账义：写下的那一行承接了这个动作的名称。

branches.en: The settlement sense, where conflict is driven through to an end.
branches.cn: 了结义：把冲突推到终结。

branches.en: The technical sense, where computing borrows the word for an all-or-nothing operation.
branches.cn: 技术义：计算机借用此词指全成或全退的操作。

intro.en: The word splits cleanly into a Latin prefix and a Latin stem, and both are still productive in English.
intro.cn: 这个词可以干净地拆成拉丁前缀与拉丁词干，两者在英语中仍能产。

latinIntro.en: Trans- and agere are among the most productive Latin pieces in English, appearing in hundreds of words.
latinIntro.cn: trans- 与 agere 是英语中最能产的拉丁部件之一，出现在数百个词里。

items.example: Transport carries goods across a distance.
items.exampleCN: transport 把货物运过一段距离。

items.example: The stem gives act and agent.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干生出 act 与 agent。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词后缀
items.example: Act gives action, and transact gives transaction.
items.exampleCN: act 生 action，transact 生 transaction。

items.example: They transacted the sale in one afternoon.
items.exampleCN: 他们一下午就办成了这笔买卖。

items.example: The goods were in transit for a week.
items.exampleCN: 货物在途中运了一周。

items.example: Transfer the money to the new account.
items.exampleCN: 把钱划到新账户上。

items.example: The agent signed on behalf of the firm.
items.exampleCN: 代理人代表公司签了字。

items.example: The agenda lists five items.
items.exampleCN: 议程上列了五项。

definition_zh: 超越；超出；胜过；凌驾于……之上
definition_en: to go beyond a limit, level or ordinary range, and in older use to surpass or excel
core_image: 山路上雾线横在脚下，一个人继续往上走，穿过云层，回头已看不见那条界线
scene: 山路上雾线横在脚下，一个人继续往上走，穿过云层，回头已看不见那条界线。Music can transcend the barrier between two languages.
sceneCN: 这里指越过某种界限（第 1 个义项：超出界限与范围）；句意为音乐能够超越两种语言之间的障碍。

pos.zh: 超越；超出；胜过；凌驾于……之上

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示状态的名词尾构成，义为「超越；超然」
由该动词的现在分词词干转成的形容词，义为「卓越的；超越的」
由前一词加表示关系的形容词尾构成，义为「先验的；超越经验的」
由形容词加表示方式的副词尾构成，义为「卓越地；超越地」

senses.title: Go beyond a limit or boundary
senses.definition: to pass across the edge of what is allowed, mapped or expected
senses.definitionCN: 越过被允许、被标定或被预期的边缘
senses.example: The path seemed to transcend the boundary of the map.
senses.exampleCN: 那条小路似乎越过了地图上的边界。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to climb over, and the oldest image is a body moving past a line rather than a number beating another number.
senses.whyCN: 那个拉丁动词意为「爬过」，最古老的意象是身体越过一条线，而不是数字胜过另一个数字。

senses.title: Rise above the material world
senses.definition: in religion and philosophy, to move beyond bodily and worldly concerns
senses.definitionCN: 在宗教与哲学中指超出身体与世俗的关切
senses.example: Monks sought to transcend the material world.
senses.exampleCN: 僧侣们寻求超越物质世界。
senses.why: A climber who leaves the ground behind is the natural picture for a soul said to leave the world behind.
senses.whyCN: 把地面留在身后的攀登者，正是用来形容灵魂把世界留在身后的自然图像。

senses.title: Surpass others in quality
senses.definition: to be so much better than rivals that comparison no longer applies
senses.definitionCN: 比对手好得多，以致比较已不适用
senses.example: Her later work transcends every rival in the same field.
senses.exampleCN: 她后期的作品超越了同领域的每一位对手。
senses.why: Here the word is close to surpass, but it claims a different level rather than a higher score.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词接近「胜过」，但它主张的是不同的层次，而不是更高的分数。

senses.title: Outlast the age that produced it
senses.definition: of an idea or work, to remain valuable beyond the period in which it was made
senses.definitionCN: 指思想或作品在产生它的时期之后仍然有价值
senses.example: Some ideas transcend the age that produced them.
senses.exampleCN: 有些思想超越了产生它们的时代。
senses.why: Time is a boundary like any other, and what crosses it survives the terms it was born in.
senses.whyCN: 时间也是一条界线，越过它的东西便活过了自己诞生时的那些条件。

senses.title: Cross the barrier between languages or cultures
senses.titleCN: 跨越语言或文化的障碍
senses.definition: of art or feeling, to reach people who do not share a tongue or a tradition
senses.definitionCN: 指艺术或情感抵达语言或传统不同的人
senses.example: Music can transcend the barrier between two languages.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐能够超越两种语言之间的障碍。
senses.why: A barrier is a wall, and the word keeps the climbing image when it says the wall was crossed.
senses.whyCN: 障碍是一道墙，而这个词在说「墙被越过」时，保留的仍是攀爬的意象。

senses.title: Go beyond one's own limits
senses.definition: of a person, to act beyond fear, habit or the role usually played
senses.definitionCN: 指人做出超出恐惧、习惯或通常角色的行为
senses.example: He tried to transcend his own fears.
senses.exampleCN: 他试图超越自己的恐惧。
senses.why: The self can be a boundary too, and the climber may be climbing out of a former self.
senses.whyCN: 自我也可以是一条界线，攀登者也许正在爬出旧的自己。

senses.title: Lie beyond possible experience
senses.definition: in philosophy, of a question or principle that cannot be tested by experience
senses.definitionCN: 哲学上指无法由经验检验的问题或原则
senses.example: Philosophers asked whether reason could transcend experience.
senses.exampleCN: 哲学家追问理性是否能超越经验。
senses.why: This is the technical sense: not better than experience, but outside the region where experience can go.
senses.whyCN: 这是术语义：不是比经验更好，而是在经验所能抵达的区域之外。

senses.title: Go beyond one's authority
senses.definition: of an order or act, to pass the legal or official power of the person who made it
senses.definitionCN: 指命令或行为越过作出者合法的或官方的权力
senses.example: The officer's order seemed to transcend his legal authority.
senses.exampleCN: 那名军官的命令似乎超越了他的法定权限。
senses.why: Authority is a line drawn by law, and crossing it uses the word in its plainest boundary sense.
senses.whyCN: 权限是法律画出的一条线，越过它就是这个词最朴素的「界线」义。

senses.title: Be above the created world
senses.definition: in theology, of the divine as separate from and higher than everything created
senses.definitionCN: 在神学中指神性独立于并高于一切受造之物
senses.example: Believers hold that the divine transcends the created world.
senses.exampleCN: 信徒认为神超越受造的世界。
senses.why: The highest use of the word places its subject not at the top of a scale but outside the scale altogether.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最高的用法，把主语放在不是刻度顶端、而是刻度之外的位置。

intro.en: Transcend comes from Latin transcendere, to climb over or go beyond, built from trans-, across, and scandere, to climb.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 transcendere「爬过、越过」，由 trans-「穿过」与 scandere「攀爬」构成。

items.en: Scandere meant to climb or ascend, and it also stands under the words for a ladder and for scanning a line of verse.
items.cn: scandere 意为攀爬、上升，它也是「梯子」与「按格律诵读诗句」等词的底层。

items.en: The compound meant to climb over or pass beyond, used of walls, hills and limits of every kind.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为爬过、越出，用于墙、山丘以及各种界限。

items.en: Medieval Latin made a noun for that which lies beyond the categories of ordinary thought.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语造出一个名词，指超出日常思想范畴的东西。

items.en: French carried the adjective into philosophy, where it named what is above the world rather than merely great in it.
items.cn: 法语把这个形容词带进哲学，用来指高于世界者，而不只是世界之内的大者。

items.en: English took the verb in the late Middle Ages; the exact first date is uncertain, and the religious sense came before the general one.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪末取用这个动词；确切首见年代不确定，宗教义先于一般义出现。

items.en: Kant fixed the modern contrast between what experience can reach and what lies beyond it.
items.cn: 康德确立了现代意义上的对比：经验能抵达的东西，与处在它之外的东西。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like transcend; the second group names neighbouring ideas of going past a limit.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 transcend 相近；第二组是与「越过限度」意思相邻的说法。

entries.definition: The state of being beyond ordinary limits or above the world.
entries.definitionCN: 指超出寻常限度或高于世界的状态。

entries.definition: Going beyond the ordinary range, often used of excellence.
entries.definitionCN: 指超出寻常范围的，常用于形容卓越。

entries.definition: Relating to what lies beyond possible experience.
entries.definitionCN: 指与超出可能经验之物相关的。

entries.definition: To climb or rise; it shares the climbing verb with a different prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 指攀登或上升；共享同一个攀爬动词，前缀不同。

entries.definition: To go down; the mirror image of climbing, built with a prefix meaning down.
entries.definitionCN: 指下降；攀爬的镜像，由意为「向下」的前缀构成。

entries.definition: To be greater than another in amount or degree; it stays inside the same scale.
entries.definitionCN: 指在数量或程度上大于另一者；它仍停留在同一把刻度之内。

entries.definition: To go past a stated number or limit; it is neutral and often numerical.
entries.definitionCN: 指超过某个明示的数字或限度；中性，常指数值。

entries.definition: To be very good at something, often the best among a group.
entries.definitionCN: 指在某方面极好，常指群体中最好的。

entries.definition: To go faster or further than another, as one runner leaves another behind.
entries.definitionCN: 指比另一者更快或更远，像一名跑者把另一名甩在身后。

entries.definition: To perform better than someone else in the same task.
entries.definitionCN: 指在同一件事上做得比他人更好。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the climbing root, the across prefix and the contrast with mere surpassing.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想利用「攀爬」的词根、「穿过」的前缀，以及它与单纯「胜过」的对比。

normal.en: The prefix means across and the verb means climb, so the word pictures someone climbing over a wall.
normal.cn: 前缀意为「穿过」，词根意为「攀爬」，于是这个词画的是有人翻过一道墙。

normal.en: A ladder, a scale and a scan all come from the same climbing verb, because climbing is measuring step by step.
normal.cn: 梯子、音阶与逐行扫读都出自同一个攀爬动词，因为攀爬正是一级一级地量。

normal.en: The mountain fog line is the picture: below it is the ordinary route, above it the view changes.
normal.cn: 山上的雾线就是那幅图：线以下是寻常路线，线以上视野就变了。

normal.en: Transcend a boundary, not just a score; surpass a score, not a boundary.
normal.cn: 超越的是界线，不只是分数；胜过的是分数，不是界线。

normal.en: The word keeps a vertical direction even when the barrier is invisible, as with language or culture.
normal.cn: 即使障碍看不见，比如语言或文化，这个词仍保留着竖直的方向。

abstract.en: To transcend is to change the frame, not to win inside the old one.
abstract.cn: 超越是换掉框架，而不是在旧框架里取胜。

abstract.en: Every boundary is drawn by someone; crossing it exposes who drew it.
abstract.cn: 每条界线都由某人画出；越过它就暴露出是谁画的。

abstract.en: The word promises a higher place, and it quietly asks what ground you are leaving.
abstract.cn: 这个词许诺一个更高的位置，也悄悄追问你正把什么地面留在身后。

examples.en: The novel transcends the genre it was written in.
examples.cn: 这部小说超越了它所属的文类。

examples.en: Great architecture can transcend time and fashion.
examples.cn: 伟大的建筑能够超越时间与风尚。

examples.en: No emergency order may transcend the constitution.
examples.cn: 任何紧急命令都不得超越宪法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「传森德」——「传」过一片「森」林，到「德」国那头，已经越过界线：超越

root: 拉丁语 scandere「攀爬」→ trans-「穿过」+ scandere 构成 transcendere「爬过、越过」→ 英语 transcend「超越」；由翻墙的具体动作，扩展为越过时代、语言、经验与权限等抽象界线。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses climb from a line on a map to the top of a scale and beyond it: limits, the material world, rivals, an age, language, the self, experience, authority and the divine.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从地图上的一条线一路爬到刻度的顶端之外：界线、物质世界、对手、时代、语言、自我、经验、权限与神性。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a walker rising through cloud until the boundary line below can no longer be seen.
core.cn: 核心意象：行走者穿过云层上升，直到脚下的界线再也看不见。

branches.en: THE LIMIT BRANCH: a path crosses the edge of the map, and an order crosses the edge of lawful power.
branches.cn: 界线分支：小路越过地图边缘，命令越过合法权力的边缘。

branches.en: THE ABOVE-THE-WORLD BRANCH: a monk leaves the material world, and the divine is said to be above all created things.
branches.cn: 高于世界分支：僧侣离开物质世界，神性被说成高于一切受造之物。

branches.en: THE COMPARISON AND TIME BRANCH: a work outclasses its rivals and outlives its age.
branches.cn: 比较与时间分支：作品胜过对手，也活过自己的时代。

branches.en: THE HUMAN BARRIER BRANCH: music crosses languages and a person crosses his own fear.
branches.cn: 人的障碍分支：音乐越过语言，人越过自己的恐惧。

branches.en: THE EXPERIENCE BRANCH: a philosophical question lies outside what any test can reach.
branches.cn: 经验分支：哲学问题处在任何检验都到不了的地方。

intro.en: Transcend is a Latin compound of across and climb, and its noun and adjective family grew inside philosophy.
intro.cn: 这是一个由「穿过」与「攀爬」构成的拉丁复合词，其名词与形容词家族在哲学里长大。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the prefix trans-, the verb scandere and the compound transcendere, plus a medieval noun in -entia.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供前缀 trans-、动词 scandere 与复合词 transcendere，以及一个带名词词尾的中世纪名词。

items.example: It gives the climbing a direction across a boundary.
items.exampleCN: 它给攀爬加上一条越过界线的方向。

items.example: The verb supplies the vertical picture under every sense.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供每个义项底下的竖直图像。

items.example: The compound is the direct source of the English verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是英语动词的直接来源。

items.example: It forms the adjective for what goes beyond.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「越出者」的形容词。

items.example: It forms the noun for the state of being beyond.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「处于之外」状态的名词。

items.example: It turns the adjective into the philosophical term.
items.exampleCN: 它把形容词变成哲学术语。

items.structure: Latin and Greek -ismus, English noun suffix
items.example: It forms transcendentalism, the doctrine of the transcendental.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transcendentalism，即先验论。

items.structure: Latin -ista, English noun suffix for a person
items.example: It forms transcendentalist, a follower of that doctrine.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transcendentalist，即信奉该学说的人。

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示状态的名词尾构成，义为「超越；超然」
由该动词的现在分词词干转成的形容词，义为「卓越的；超越的」
由前一词加表示关系的形容词尾构成，义为「先验的；超越经验的」
由形容词加表示方式的副词尾构成，义为「卓越地；超越地」

definition_zh: 成绩单；文字稿；抄本
definition_en: an official record of the grades of a student, or a written copy of spoken words or of a document
core_image: 一张盖章的纸，把课堂上的话和分数一字不差地搬下来
scene: 申请研究生时，学校要求随材料提交盖章的学业记录。The university asked for an official transcript with the application.
sceneCN: 这里 transcript 是「成绩单」（第 1 个义项：学校出具的官方学业记录）；句意：申请时，学校要求随材料提交一份官方成绩单。

derivatives.zh: 转录；抄写；转写文本
把口头内容写成文字；抄录
转录酶（生物化学术语）

senses.title: An official academic record
senses.definition: an official document listing the courses and grades of a student
senses.definitionCN: 列出学生所学课程与成绩的官方文件
senses.example: The graduate sent her transcript to the admissions office.
senses.exampleCN: 这位毕业生把成绩单寄给了招生办公室。
senses.why: Latin transcriptum is a thing written across, a copy; the school copy of a student record became the transcript.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 transcriptum 指「抄写过来的文本」，即副本；学校抄存的学生记录就成了成绩单。

senses.title: A written version of speech
senses.definition: a written copy of words that were spoken, such as an interview or a court hearing
senses.definitionCN: 把说出口的话写下来的文本，如访谈或庭审记录
senses.example: The lawyer read the transcript of the witness.
senses.exampleCN: 律师读了证人的证词记录。
senses.why: The copy sense narrows to speech written down word for word.
senses.whyCN: 「副本」的意思收窄到「把话一字不差写下来」，于是有了文字稿。

senses.title: A written copy of a document
senses.definition: a copy of a document written out from an original
senses.definitionCN: 依原件抄写而成的文件副本
senses.example: The archive keeps a transcript of the old charter.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆保存着那份旧宪章的抄本。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: a document written across from another.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：从另一份文件「抄写过来」的文本。

senses.title: An RNA copy in biology
senses.definition: a piece of RNA made from a gene, which carries its message
senses.definitionCN: 由基因生成、携带其信息的一段核糖核酸
senses.example: The cell makes a transcript of the gene.
senses.exampleCN: 细胞为该基因生成一份转录本。
senses.why: Molecular biology borrows the copy image for the RNA copied from DNA.
senses.whyCN: 分子生物学借用「副本」的意象，指从脱氧核糖核酸抄录出的核糖核酸。

intro.en: Transcript joins Latin trans-, across, with scribere, to write; a transcript is writing carried across from a source.
intro.cn: transcript 由拉丁语 trans-（穿过、越过）与 scribere（写）组合；它的本义是「从某个来源抄写过来的文字」。

items.en: Trans means across, and scribere means to write.
items.cn: trans 意为穿过、越过，scribere 意为书写。

items.en: Scriptum names a thing that has been written.
items.cn: scriptum 指写下来的东西。

items.en: Transcriptum names a copy written out from an original.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 transcriptum 指依原件抄出的副本。

items.en: Transcript names a written copy of a document.
items.cn: 十三世纪起，transcript 指文件的书面副本。

items.en: American colleges give the word its sense of an academic record.
items.cn: 十九世纪美国高校赋予该词「学业记录」的意思。

items.en: The word also names speech written down and an RNA copy.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词也指写下来的讲话与核糖核酸副本。

note.en: Transcript pairs trans- with scribere, next to transcribe and transcription, and it sits near the record words of school and court.
note.cn: transcript 把 trans- 与 scribere 配在一起，与 transcribe、transcription 同根，也与学校、法庭的记录类词相邻。

entries.definition: to write down words or copy a record
the act or product of transcribing
written text
a written account of facts
an official document that proves something
a document proving a qualification

normalIntro.en: Trans- means across and script means writing, so a transcript is writing carried across from one form to another.
normalIntro.cn: trans- 意为「越过」，script 意为「写」，所以 transcript 就是「从一种形式抄写到另一种形式」的文本。

normal.en: A transcript of a course lists the grades you earned.
normal.cn: 课程的成绩单列出你获得的分数。

normal.en: An interview transcript writes down every word that was said.
normal.cn: 访谈文字稿把说过的每句话都写下来。

normal.en: Transcribe is the verb, transcription is the act or the text.
normal.cn: transcribe 是动词，transcription 是动作或成品。

normal.en: The same root gives script, describe and manuscript.
normal.cn: 同一个词根还给出 script、describe 与 manuscript。

normal.en: Compare certificate: a certificate proves a fact, a transcript lists grades.
normal.cn: 对比 certificate：证明书证明某个事实，成绩单列出各科分数。

abstract.en: Picture a clerk copying a page from one book into another.
abstract.cn: 想象书记员把一页内容从一本书抄到另一本书。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed sheet of grades sliding into an envelope.
abstract.cn: 想象一张盖章的成绩单滑进信封。

abstract.en: Picture a recorder turning sound into lines on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象录音机把声音变成纸上的一行行字。

examples.en: You must order an official transcript for each application.
examples.cn: 每份申请你都要单独申请一份官方成绩单。

examples.en: The transcript of the hearing runs to forty pages.
examples.cn: 这场听证会的记录长达四十页。

examples.en: Reporters checked the interview transcript before printing it.
examples.cn: 记者在刊印前核对了访谈文字稿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「transcript」读近「穿斯克瑞普特」——把课堂表现「穿」成文字，再盖章成成绩单；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过、越过）+ scribere（写）→ 中世纪拉丁语 transcriptum（抄写出的文本）→ 英语 transcript；核心义「抄写下来的文本」，故有成绩单、文字稿、抄本。

sensesIntro.en: Transcript begins as a copy written out from a document, then narrows to speech written down, widens to the school grade record, and is borrowed for an RNA copy.
sensesIntro.cn: transcript 先指依文件抄出的副本，再收窄为写下来的讲话，又扩大为学校成绩记录，最后被借作核糖核酸的转录本。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page copied across, word for word, and sealed.
core.cn: 核心意象：把内容一字不差抄到另一张纸上并盖章。

branches.en: The school record is the everyday sense for applicants.
branches.cn: 学校记录是申请人最常遇到的义项。

branches.en: Speech written down extends the copy to talk.
branches.cn: 把讲话写下来，把「副本」扩展到口语。

branches.en: The document copy is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 文件副本是最古老的义项。

branches.en: The RNA copy borrows the image for biology.
branches.cn: 核糖核酸副本把这一意象借给了生物学。

branches.en: Both a grade sheet and a speech record are copied text.
branches.cn: 成绩单与讲话记录都是抄写而成的文本。

intro.en: Transcript joins Latin trans-, across, with scribere, to write; the same parts build transcribe and transcription.
intro.cn: transcript 由拉丁语 trans-（穿过）与 scribere（写）构成；同样的部件还构成 transcribe 与 transcription。

latinIntro.en: Latin trans means across and scribere means to write; transcriptum is a copy written out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trans 意为穿过，scribere 意为书写；transcriptum 指抄写出来的副本。

items.example: Trans- marks movement across.
items.exampleCN: trans- 标记「横越」的动作。

items.example: Scribere is the writing root.
items.exampleCN: scribere 是「写」的词根。

items.example: Scriptum is the written product.
items.exampleCN: scriptum 是写出来的成品。

items.example: Transcript keeps the copy sense.
items.exampleCN: transcript 保留「副本」之义。

items.example: Transcription adds the action suffix.
items.exampleCN: transcription 加上表示动作的后缀。

items.example: Transcribe is the verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: transcribe 是这一词族的动词。

items.example: Scribe names the person who writes.
items.exampleCN: scribe 指书写的人。

items.example: Script is the bare writing root.
items.exampleCN: script 是「写」这一词根最直接的形式。

items.meaning: to write or tell about something
items.example: Describe joins de- with scribere.
items.exampleCN: describe 由 de- 与 scribere 组合。

items.example: Manuscript joins hand and writing.
items.exampleCN: manuscript 把「手」与「写」合起来。

definition_zh: 转移；调动；转学；转让；换乘；转账
definition_en: to move someone or something from one place, job, or owner to another
core_image: 一箱行李被人从一辆车搬上另一辆车，位置变了，东西没变
scene: 开学一周后，教务处通知他可以去另一个校区读同样的专业。He applied to transfer to the campus nearer his home.
sceneCN: 这里 transfer 是「转学」（第 4 个义项：从一所学校转到另一所）；句意为他申请转到离家更近的校区。画面里有教务处窗口与两个校区的指示牌。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ence 构成名词，义为「转移；移转」
由动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可转移的；可转让的」
由动词加 -ee 构成，义为「受让人；被调动者」

senses.title: To move something from one place to another
senses.definition: to move a person or thing from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物从一个地方搬到另一个地方
senses.example: They transferred the files to a new cabinet.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把档案搬到了一个新柜子里。
senses.why: Latin ferre means to carry, and trans- means across, so the verb is simply to carry across.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ferre 意为搬运，trans- 意为跨过，动词本义就是「搬过去」。

senses.title: To move money between accounts
senses.definition: to send money from one account or person to another
senses.definitionCN: 把钱从一个账户或一个人转到另一个
senses.example: Please transfer the deposit before Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 请在周五前把定金转过来。
senses.why: Money is carried across from one account to another, so the oldest physical sense fits exactly.
senses.whyCN: 钱被从一端「搬」到另一端，最古老的字面义正好贴合。

senses.title: To move to a different job or branch
senses.definition: to be moved officially to another post, office, or department
senses.definitionCN: 被正式调到另一个岗位、办事处或部门
senses.example: She was transferred to the Shanghai office in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她春天被调到上海办事处。
senses.why: A worker carried from one post to another is the same crossing, only of people instead of boxes.
senses.whyCN: 人被从一岗「搬」到另一岗，同样是跨越，只是搬的是人不是箱子。

senses.title: To change schools or courses
senses.definition: to move from one school, college, or course to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一所学校、学院或课程转到另一个
senses.example: He hopes to transfer to a university nearer home.
senses.exampleCN: 他希望转到离家更近的大学。
senses.why: Students carry their credits across institutions, so the school sense is a special case of the general one.
senses.whyCN: 学生把学分带到另一所学校，所以学校义项是一般义项的特例。

senses.title: To hand over ownership or rights
senses.definition: to give the legal ownership of something to another person
senses.definitionCN: 把某物的合法所有权交给他人
senses.example: The old man transferred the land to his daughter.
senses.exampleCN: 老人把土地转给了女儿。
senses.why: Ownership can also be carried across from one name to another, which is why lawyers use the word.
senses.whyCN: 所有权也能从一个人名下「搬」到另一个人名下，所以法律上常用这个词。

senses.title: To change from one vehicle to another
senses.definition: to get off one bus or train and continue on another
senses.definitionCN: 下了一趟公交或地铁，改乘另一趟继续
senses.example: Transfer at the third stop and take the line going east.
senses.exampleCN: 在第三站换乘往东的那条线。
senses.why: The passenger is carried across from one line to another, keeping the same journey.
senses.whyCN: 乘客被从一条线「带」到另一条线，行程却是同一段。

intro.en: Transfer comes from Latin transferre, to carry across, built from trans-, across, and ferre, to bear or carry.
intro.cn: transfer 来自拉丁语 transferre（搬运过去），由 trans-（跨过）与 ferre（承载）构成。

items.en: Ferre means to bear or carry, and its forms appear throughout English in words of carrying and offering.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ferre 意为承载、搬运，其各种形式遍布英语中表示搬运与提供的词。

items.en: Transferre means to carry across, to translate, and also to put off to another time.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transferre 意为搬运过去、翻译，也表示把事情推到另一个时间。

items.en: The noun transferre becomes translatus in the participle, which gives the English word translate.
items.cn: 其分词形式 translatus 后来生出了英语的 translate。

items.en: Old French transferer keeps the sense of moving a thing or a right from one holder to another.
items.cn: 古法语 transferer 保留了把物品或权利从一方转到另一方的含义。

items.en: English takes the word in the fourteenth century, first for moving rights and property.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入此词，最初用于移转权利与财产。

items.en: Later senses follow the railways and the banks: changing trains, then moving money between accounts.
items.cn: 后来的义项随铁路与银行而来：先是换乘，再是账户间的转账。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the trans- prefix and ferre stem, while the near-meaning group gathers verbs of moving and handing over.
note.cn: 形近组共用 trans- 前缀与 ferre 词干，近义组汇集表示移动与移交的动词。

entries.definition: the act of moving something across
able to be moved or handed over
to change the form of something
to carry goods or people from place to place
to change place or position
to move a business or person to a new place
to give control or ownership to someone else
to change from one thing or route to another

normalIntro.en: The word is a transparent Latin compound, so learning ferre once pays off many times.
normalIntro.cn: 这是个透明的拉丁复合词，把 ferre 记一次可用在很多地方。

normal.en: Trans- is the same as in transport and translate, all meaning across.
normal.cn: trans- 与 transport、translate 中是同一个，都表示「跨过」。

normal.en: Ferre means carry, so transfer is carry across, nothing more.
normal.cn: ferre 意为搬运，所以 transfer 就是「搬过去」，别无他意。

normal.en: Other ferre words: offer, prefer, refer, suffer, all about bearing something.
normal.cn: 其他 ferre 词：offer、prefer、refer、suffer，都与「承受、带来」有关。

normal.en: Spelling note: the final r doubles before a vowel, as in transferred and transferring.
normal.cn: 拼写提示：接元音词尾时词尾 r 要双写，如 transferred、transferring。

normal.en: As a noun the stress falls forward, TRANS-fer, while the verb says trans-FER.
normal.cn: 作名词时重音在前（TRANS-fer），作动词时重音在后（trans-FER）。

abstract.en: Picture a suitcase lifted from the trunk of one car into another, the same case in a new boot.
abstract.cn: 想象一只行李箱从一辆车的后备箱被抬进另一辆，箱子没变，位置变了。

abstract.en: Now let the suitcase become a sum of money moving between two computer screens.
abstract.cn: 再让这只箱子变成一笔钱，在两块屏幕之间移动。

abstract.en: Finally see a passenger stepping off one train and onto the one across the platform.
abstract.cn: 最后看到一位乘客下一趟车，走上对面站台的那一趟。

examples.en: She transferred a thousand yuan into her son's account.
examples.cn: 她往儿子的账户里转了一千元。

examples.en: He was transferred to the night shift without warning.
examples.cn: 他在毫无预警的情况下被调到夜班。

examples.en: You can transfer at the next station to the airport line.
examples.cn: 你可以在下一站换乘机场线。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯佛」——穿过一道门，佛把东西递到对面，就是转移。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨过）+ ferre（承载；搬运），名词 trans- + ferre；同族有 transport、translate、refer、offer

sensesIntro.en: Every sense is one act of carrying something across a boundary, whether goods, money, a job, a school, a title, or a platform.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都是把某样东西搬过一道界限：货物、钱、岗位、学校、产权或站台。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a load lifted across from one place, holder, or line to another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件东西被抬过界限，从一处、一人或一条线到另一处。

branches.en: The physical family: goods and money carried from one place or account to another.
branches.cn: 实体一族：货物与钱被搬到另一处或另一账户。

branches.en: The career family: a worker moved to a new post, a student to a new school.
branches.cn: 职业一族：员工调到新岗位，学生转到新学校。

branches.en: The legal sense, where what crosses is ownership rather than an object.
branches.cn: 法律义：跨过去的是所有权，而不是实物。

branches.en: The travel sense, where the passenger crosses between two lines.
branches.cn: 出行义：乘客在两条线路之间跨越。

branches.en: Both are abstract crossings, one of value, one of right, and both keep the physical image.
branches.cn: 两者都是抽象跨越，一个跨价值，一个跨权利，而实体画面都还保留着。

intro.en: A Latin prefix plus a Latin verb stem, unchanged for two thousand years in meaning.
intro.cn: 一个拉丁前缀加一个拉丁动词词干，两千年来含义几乎没变。

latinIntro.en: Trans- and ferre are both highly productive, and recognising them unlocks a large family.
latinIntro.cn: trans- 与 ferre 都极能产，认出两者就能打开一大族词。

items.example: Transatlantic means across the Atlantic.
items.exampleCN: transatlantic 意为跨越大西洋的。

items.example: The stem appears in refer and prefer.
items.exampleCN: 该词干出现在 refer 与 prefer 中。

items.example: A ticket is transferable to another date.
items.exampleCN: 车票可以改到另一个日期使用。

items.example: The transferee signs the deed.
items.exampleCN: 受让人在契据上签字。

items.example: She translated the letter into English.
items.exampleCN: 她把信译成了英语。

items.meaning: to carry from place to place
items.example: Trucks transport grain to the port.
items.exampleCN: 卡车把粮食运到港口。

items.meaning: to carry back, to point to
items.example: The note refers to page ten.
items.exampleCN: 注里提到第十页。

items.example: They offered him a new contract.
items.exampleCN: 他们给他提供了一份新合同。

definition_zh: 使改变；使改观；转化；变换
definition_en: to change something completely, especially in form, appearance, or nature
core_image: 破旧的仓库在夜里被灯光点亮，变成一间明亮的画廊
scene: 旧城区的一座废弃仓库，工人们用了三年把它改成展厅。They transformed a warehouse into a museum of light.
sceneCN: 这里 transform 是「使改变；使改观」（第 1 个义项：彻底改变形式、外观或性质）；句意为他们把仓库改造成了一座关于光的博物馆。夜里被点亮的旧仓库，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 transform 加 -ation 构成，义为「转变；改造」
由 transform 加 -ative 构成，义为「有变革作用的」
由 transform 加 -er 构成，义为「变压器；改造者」

senses.title: A complete change of form
senses.definition: to change something so completely that it is no longer the same in form or nature
senses.definitionCN: 彻底改变某物，使其形式或性质与原先不同
senses.example: They transformed a warehouse into a museum of light.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把一座仓库改造成了一座关于光的博物馆。
senses.why: The Latin shape trans plus forma means across form: the thing crosses from one shape to another.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 trans 加 forma 意为「越过形式」：事物从一种形状跨到另一种形状。

senses.title: A changed appearance
senses.definition: to improve the appearance of a place or person very noticeably
senses.definitionCN: 显著改善地方或人的外观
senses.example: A coat of fresh paint transformed the front of the house.
senses.exampleCN: 一层新漆让房子的正面完全变了样。
senses.why: When only the outside changes, the word still works, because a new look is a new form.
senses.whyCN: 只改外表时这个词同样适用，因为新的样子就是新的形式。

senses.title: A change from one state to another
senses.definition: to change energy, data, or a figure from one form into another
senses.definitionCN: 把能量、数据或数值由一种形式变为另一种
senses.example: The panels transform sunlight into electricity.
senses.exampleCN: 这些板把阳光转化为电能。
senses.why: Technical use keeps the oldest sense, energy crossing from one form into another.
senses.whyCN: 技术用法保留了最古老的含义：能量从一种形式跨入另一种形式。

intro.en: Transform is a Latin compound of trans, across, and forma, shape, borrowed into English in one piece.
intro.cn: transform 是拉丁语 trans（越过）与 forma（形状）构成的复合词，整体借入英语。

items.en: Forma meant a shape or mould, the outline that gives a thing its identity.
items.cn: forma 意为形状或模子，是赋予事物身份的轮廓。

items.en: The verb transformare meant to change the shape of something.
items.cn: 动词 transformare 意为改变某物的形状。

items.en: French softened the word into transformer, still tied to shape and appearance.
items.cn: 法语把它柔化为 transformer，仍与形状、外观相连。

items.en: English took transform in the field of mathematics, where one figure becomes another.
items.cn: 英语先在数学领域使用 transform，指一个图形变为另一个图形。

items.en: The meaning widened to buildings, people, and energy, always with the sense of a complete change.
items.cn: 词义扩展到建筑、人和能量，始终带着彻底改变的意思。

note.en: The first group shares the trans stem, the second holds other verbs of change.
note.cn: 第一组共享 trans 词干，第二组收其他表示改变的动词。

entries.definition: A complete change in form.
A device that changes voltage, or one who transforms.
Able to cause a deep change.
To change into another form or use.
To change something slightly.
To give a new shape or structure.

normalIntro.en: Transform splits neatly into trans, across, and form, shape, so the meaning is visible in the spelling.
normalIntro.cn: transform 可以干净地切成 trans（跨越）与 form（形状），词义直接写在拼写里。

normal.en: Trans appears in transport and translate, all about moving across.
normal.cn: trans 也出现在 transport 与 translate 里，都与跨越有关。

normal.en: Form is the shape, so transform is to carry something over into a new shape.
normal.cn: form 是形状，所以 transform 是把某物带进新的形状。

normal.en: The stress falls on the second syllable: transFORM.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：transFORM。

normal.en: The noun adds -ation to become transformation.
normal.cn: 名词加 -ation 变成 transformation。

normal.en: A transformer in a street changes voltage from one level to another.
normal.cn: 街上的变压器把电压从一个等级换到另一个等级。

abstract.en: A grey wall turning gold under a lamp.
abstract.cn: 灰墙在灯下变成金色。

abstract.en: The same clay before and after the hands of the potter.
abstract.cn: 同一团泥在陶工手中前后的样子。

abstract.en: A door opening onto a room that was not there before.
abstract.cn: 一扇门打开后出现原本不存在的房间。

examples.en: The new railway transformed the small town into a busy city.
examples.cn: 新铁路把小镇变成了繁忙的城市。

examples.en: Learning a second language can transform the way you think.
examples.cn: 学习第二门语言能改变你思考的方式。

examples.en: Engineers transform heat into power inside the plant.
examples.cn: 工程师在厂里把热量转化为动力。

dict_mnemonic.text: trans（跨过）＋ form（形状）——跨过一个形状，进入另一个形状，就是改变。

root: 拉丁语 transformare，由 trans（越过、穿过）与 forma（形状）构成，本义「改变形状」；同族词有 transformation、transformer、transformative。

sensesIntro.en: The deepest change of form comes first, then the change of appearance, then the technical change from one state to another.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是形式上的彻底改变，再是外观的改观，最后是技术意义上从一种状态到另一种状态的转换。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old shed lit up as a gallery.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧棚屋被点成画廊。

branches.en: The form branch: one shape becomes another.
branches.cn: 形式分支：一种形状变为另一种。

branches.en: The look branch: the outside changes before the inside.
branches.cn: 外观分支：外表先于内里改变。

branches.en: The state branch: energy and data cross over.
branches.cn: 状态分支：能量与数据跨越形式。

branches.en: The technique branch: engineers use the same verb.
branches.cn: 技术分支：工程师用同一个动词。

branches.en: The human branch: a person or a place can be remade.
branches.cn: 人分支：人和地方都能被重造。

intro.en: Transform is a Latin compound whose two parts, trans and form, still work as English building blocks.
intro.cn: transform 是拉丁语复合词，其两部分 trans 与 form 至今仍是英语的构词积木。

latinIntro.en: Latin forma, shape, and trans, across, are the direct parents, and both left many relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 forma（形状）与 trans（越过）是直接来源，两者都留下众多亲属。

items.example: It carries the idea of crossing in transform.
items.exampleCN: 它把跨越的意思带进 transform。

items.example: The stem names what is being changed.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干指被改变的东西。

items.meaning: the act or result of an action
items.example: It forms transformation, the act of changing form.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transformation，改变形式的行为。

items.example: It forms transformative, able to transform.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transformative，具有改变之力的。

items.example: It forms transformer, the device or person that transforms.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transformer，进行变换的装置或人。

items.example: Re adds the sense of doing it again.
items.exampleCN: re 加上再做一次的意思。

items.example: Uni means one, so two forms become one.
items.exampleCN: uni 意为单一，于是两种样子合成一种。

items.example: A formula is a fixed shape of words or signs.
items.exampleCN: formula 就是词语或符号的固定形状。

definition_zh: 转变；改造；转型；（数学）变换；（生物）转化
definition_en: a thorough change in form, nature or appearance, or the result of such a change
core_image: 同一团黏土在手中被重新塑成完全不同的形状，材质未变而形态全非
scene: 这里指「转变」。 The city underwent a complete transformation after the harbor was rebuilt.
sceneCN: 这里 transformation 指「转变」（第 1 个义项：形态或性质发生根本变化）；句意：港口重建之后，这座城市经历了彻底的转变。图中可辨识物件：新旧街区对照图、起重机、被重新规划的岸线。

pos.zh: 转变；改造；转型；变换；转化（可数，指一次具体变化；也可不可数，指变化过程）

derivatives.zh: 使改变形态；改造；变换
变压器；变形者
有变革作用的；起改造作用的
转换的；变革的（transformational grammar 转换语法）
被改变的；变形后的

senses.title: Radical Change of Form
senses.titleCN: 转变：形态或性质的根本改变
senses.definition: a thorough change in the form or nature of something
senses.definitionCN: 事物形态或性质发生的彻底变化
senses.example: The city underwent a complete transformation after the harbor was rebuilt.
senses.exampleCN: 港口重建之后，这座城市经历了彻底的转变。
senses.why: Trans- means 'across' and forma means 'form'. The noun names a crossing from one form to another, and the prefix promises that the distance travelled is large, not a small adjustment.
senses.whyCN: trans- 意为「跨越」，forma 意为「形状」。这个名词命名的是从一种形态跨到另一种形态，而前缀保证跨越的距离很大，不是小修小补。

senses.title: The Changed Result
senses.titleCN: 变化后的形态：转变的产物
senses.definition: the new form that results from such a change
senses.definitionCN: 这种变化所产生的新形态
senses.example: Her final transformation into a singer surprised the whole family.
senses.exampleCN: 她最终转变为一名歌手，让全家人都感到意外。
senses.why: The same noun can name either the journey or the place arrived at. Context decides which is meant, and English often uses 'a transformation' for the resulting new state.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词既可指旅程，也可指到达之处；语境决定所指，而英语常用 a transformation 来指变化后的新状态。

senses.title: Mathematical Mapping
senses.titleCN: 数学变换：点与点之间的对应
senses.definition: a rule or mapping that carries each point or value to another
senses.definitionCN: 把每个点或数值对应到另一个点或数值的规则
senses.example: A rotation is a transformation that preserves distance.
senses.exampleCN: 旋转是一种保持距离不变的变换。
senses.why: Mathematics borrows the word for a change of position or representation that follows a rule. Nothing physical changes; only the coordinates do, which is why the term is so useful.
senses.whyCN: 数学借这个词表示按规则进行的方位或表示方式变化；没有任何实物改变，变的只是坐标——这正是该术语极其有用的原因。

senses.title: Genetic Transformation
senses.titleCN: 遗传转化：细胞接纳外源基因
senses.definition: the introduction of foreign DNA into a cell so that it takes up the new genes
senses.definitionCN: 把外源 DNA 引入细胞，使其接纳新基因
senses.example: The lab used transformation to insert a resistance gene into the bacteria.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室用转化把一段抗性基因插入细菌。
senses.why: In biology the change is a lasting alteration of the cell's inherited material. The general sense of 'form changed from outside' narrows into 'genome changed from outside'.
senses.whyCN: 在生物学里，变化是对细胞遗传物质的持久改动；「由外部改变形态」的一般含义收窄为「由外部改变基因组」。

senses.title: Syntactic Rewriting
senses.titleCN: 语言学转换：句式的重写
senses.definition: a rule that rewrites one sentence structure into another with the same meaning
senses.definitionCN: 把一种句式改写成另一种同义句式的规则
senses.example: The passive sentence is derived by transformation from the active one.
senses.exampleCN: 被动句由主动句经转换生成。
senses.why: Transformational grammar treats a sentence as passing through rule-governed rewrites. The word is apt because the meaning survives while the shape of the sentence changes.
senses.whyCN: 转换语法把句子看作经过一系列规则化改写；这个词用得很贴切，因为句子的意义保留下来，而句子的外形改变了。

senses.title: Personal Change
senses.titleCN: 人的转变：性情或处境改观
senses.definition: a deep change in a person's character, health or circumstances
senses.definitionCN: 一个人性格、健康或处境的深刻变化
senses.example: Years of care brought about a slow transformation in him.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的照料使他慢慢发生了转变。
senses.why: The noun is not limited to visible shapes. A person's life can cross from one form to another, and the word then carries hope or moral weight rather than geometry.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词并不限于可见的形状；一个人的生活可以从一种形态跨到另一种，此时该词承载的是希望或道德分量，而不是几何意味。

senses.title: Energy Conversion
senses.titleCN: 能量转换：从一种形式到另一种
senses.definition: the change of energy from one form into another
senses.definitionCN: 能量由一种形式变为另一种形式
senses.example: A turbine converts heat into motion through a series of transformations.
senses.exampleCN: 涡轮通过一连串能量转换把热变成运动。
senses.why: Physics uses the oldest literal sense: the energy is the same quantity but appears in a new form. The prefix trans- is exact here, since the amount is conserved while its dress changes.
senses.whyCN: 物理学用的是最古老的字面义：能量总量不变，只是以新形式出现；这里 trans- 非常准确，因为总量守恒，改变的只是它的「外衣」。

senses.title: Structural Overhaul
senses.titleCN: 结构性改造：体制或产业重构
senses.definition: a far-reaching reorganization of an institution, economy or system
senses.definitionCN: 机构、经济或体制的深远重组
senses.example: The transformation of the postal service took a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 邮政系统的改造用了十年。
senses.why: When the object is an organization, the change is in its structure rather than its surface. The word then belongs to policy and management talk, where it signals depth and scale.
senses.whyCN: 当对象是组织机构时，改变的是结构而非表面；此时该词属于政策与管理话语，标出的是深度与规模。

intro.en: Transformation comes from Late Latin transformatio, built on the verb transformare, itself trans- 'across' plus forma 'form'. It reached English through Old French, so the exact first date is approximate.
intro.cn: transformation 出自晚期拉丁 transformatio，它建立在动词 transformare 之上，而 transformare 即 trans-「跨越」加 forma「形状」。该词经古法语进入英语，确切首见年代为约数。

items.en: Latin forma named a shape, a mould and, by extension, a pattern or beauty. Its family reaches English in form, formal, format, formula, uniform and reform.
items.cn: 拉丁 forma 指形状、模子，并引申指样式或美。其词族以 form、formal、format、formula、uniform、reform 等进入英语。

items.en: Transformare joined trans- 'across' to formare 'to shape', giving 'to shape across, to change the form of'. Classical Latin used it for changing appearance as well as for metamorphosis.
items.cn: transformare 把 trans-「跨越」与 formare「塑造」结合，意为「跨形塑造、改变形状」。古典拉丁既用它指改变外观，也指变形。

items.en: The action noun transformatio named the act of changing form. The -tio suffix marks a completed act viewed as a thing, which is why English -ation nouns so often feel like events.
items.cn: 动作名词 transformatio 指改变形状的行为。-tio 后缀把完成的动作当作一个事物来看，因此英语 -ation 名词常带有「事件」的质感。

items.en: Transformation entered English around the fourteenth century through Old French transformation. Early uses were mostly religious, for a change of the soul or the body.
items.cn: transformation 约于十四世纪经古法语 transformation 进入英语；早期用法多属宗教语境，指灵魂或身体的改变。

items.en: Mathematics, physics and biology later borrowed the word for rule-bound changes of coordinates, of energy form and of genetic material. The core idea stayed the same: one form crosses into another.
items.cn: 数学、物理学与生物学后来借这个词表示受规则约束的坐标变化、能量形式变化与遗传物质变化；核心观念未变：一种形态跨越到另一种形态。

note.en: The first group separates forms built on the same Latin root or on a neighbouring concept. The second holds near-synonyms that differ in scale, speed or type of change.
note.cn: 第一组区分同出拉丁词根、或概念相邻的形态；第二组是变化规模、速度或类型不同的近义词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning 'to change the form of'. It names the doing, while transformation names the deed or its result.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，意为「改变……的形态」；它表示做的动作，而 transformation 表示这一行为或其结果。

entries.definition: The process of passing from one state to another. It stresses the interval, whereas transformation stresses how different the end state is.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指从一种状态转到另一种状态的过程；它强调中间那段间隔，而 transformation 强调终态差异之大。

entries.definition: A change of one substance or element into another, historically linked to alchemy. It is narrower and more dramatic than transformation.
entries.definitionCN: 指一种物质或元素变成另一种，历史上与炼金术相关；比 transformation 更狭窄、更具戏剧性。

entries.definition: Any difference from a previous state. It says nothing about depth, so it can describe a swapped label or a remade city.
entries.definitionCN: 任何与先前状态的差异；不涉及深度，因此既可指换了一个标签，也可指重建一座城市。

entries.definition: A change from one use, purpose or system to another, as a barn converted into a house. It stresses function rather than shape.
entries.definitionCN: 从一种用途、目的或制度转为另一种，如谷仓改作住宅；强调功能而非形状。

entries.definition: A complete change of form, especially in an animal's development. It is more vivid and more specific than transformation.
entries.definitionCN: 形态的彻底改变，尤指动物发育过程；比 transformation 更生动、更具体。

entries.definition: A thorough examination and repair of a system or machine. It implies restoring fitness rather than becoming something new.
entries.definitionCN: 对系统或机器的彻底检查与修理；暗示恢复良好状态，而不是变成新事物。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: trans- 'across' + forma 'form' + -ation: a crossing from one shape to another.
normal.cn: trans-「跨越」+ forma「形状」+ -ation：从一种形状跨到另一种形状。

normal.en: The family runs transform, transformation, transformer, transformative, transformational, form, format, formula.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 transform、transformation、transformer、transformative、transformational、form、format、formula。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the domains: digital transformation, economic transformation, genetic transformation, energy transformation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：数字化转型、经济转型、遗传转化、能量转换。

normal.en: transition is the passage; transformation is the difference between the ends.
normal.cn: transition 是过程，transformation 是两端之间的差异。

normal.en: A transformer in the street changes voltage, a literal child of this family.
normal.cn: 街上的变压器改变电压，正是这个词族的字面后代。

abstract.en: Picture a caterpillar dissolving inside a shell and a winged thing climbing out.
abstract.cn: 想象一条毛虫在壳内溶解，一个有翅的东西爬出来。

abstract.en: Picture the same lump of clay becoming a bowl, then a cup, then a bird.
abstract.cn: 想象同一团黏土先变成碗，再变成杯，再变成一只鸟。

abstract.en: Picture a street that looks the same on the map but is unrecognizable from the pavement.
abstract.cn: 想象一条街在地图上没变，站在人行道上却已认不出来。

examples.en: The transformation of the old mill into a museum took three years.
examples.cn: 把旧磨坊改造成博物馆花了三年。

examples.en: Energy transformation always leaves some heat behind.
examples.cn: 能量转换总会留下一些热。

examples.en: His transformation from clerk to mayor surprised no one who knew him.
examples.cn: 他从职员变成市长，认识他的人都不觉得意外。

dict_mnemonic.text: trans（跨越）+ form（形状）+ ation（名词词尾）→ 跨过原有形状 → 转变、改造

root: 拉丁 trans-「跨越」+ forma「形状、模子」→ transformare「改变形状」→ 晚期拉丁 transformatio → 古法语 transformation → 英语 transformation。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share the picture of crossing from one form to another, applied to an object, a result, a mathematical rule, a cell, a sentence, a person, energy and an institution.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享同一幅画面——从一种形态跨到另一种形态——只是施加于对象、结果、数学规则、细胞、句子、人、能量与机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same clay reshaped into a different figure, material unchanged.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一团黏土被重新塑成另一个样子，材质未变。

branches.en: THE JOURNEY AND THE ARRIVAL: one noun names both the act of changing and the new form that results.
branches.cn: 旅程与抵达：同一个名词既指变化的行为，也指变化所产生的新形态。

branches.en: RULE-GOVERNED REWRITING: points and sentences are carried to new positions or shapes while relations are preserved.
branches.cn: 受规则约束的改写：点与句子被带到新位置或新外形，而关系保持不变。

branches.en: MATERIAL FROM OUTSIDE: a cell takes in foreign genes, so the change enters the inherited substance itself.
branches.cn: 外来物质：细胞接纳外源基因，变化深入到遗传物质本身。

branches.en: INNER AND INSTITUTIONAL: a person or an organization crosses into a new state, and the word gains moral or political weight.
branches.cn: 个人与机构：人或组织跨入新状态，该词由此获得道德或政治分量。

branches.en: CONSERVED QUANTITY: energy changes dress but not amount, the most literal use of trans-.
branches.cn: 守恒的量：能量换了外衣却不改总量，这是 trans- 最字面的用法。

intro.en: Transformation is a Latin action noun: a prefix of crossing, the root for form, a verb-forming suffix and a noun ending that turns the act into a thing.
intro.cn: transformation 是拉丁动作名词：表示跨越的前缀、表示形状的词根、构成动词的后缀，以及把行为变成事物的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin forma supplies form, formal, format, formula, uniform and reform; transformare adds the crossing prefix and supplies transform, transformation, transformer and transformative.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 forma 衍生 form、formal、format、formula、uniform、reform；transformare 加上跨越前缀，衍生 transform、transformation、transformer、transformative。

items.meaning: the act or result of changing form
items.meaningCN: 改变形态的行为或结果
items.example: The transformation left the outer walls intact.
items.exampleCN: 这次改造保留了外墙。

items.example: New irrigation transformed the valley.
items.exampleCN: 新的灌溉改变了山谷的面貌。

items.meaning: a device or person that transforms
items.example: The transformer stepped the voltage down.
items.exampleCN: 变压器把电压降了下来。

items.meaning: having the power to change something deeply
items.example: The trip was a transformative experience.
items.exampleCN: 那次旅行是一次具有改变作用的经历。

items.example: Transformational grammar rewrites deep structures.
items.exampleCN: 转换语法改写深层结构。

items.example: Water takes the form of its container.
items.exampleCN: 水会呈现容器的形状。

items.example: The walls were painted a uniform grey.
items.exampleCN: 墙壁被刷成统一的灰色。

items.meaning: to shape again, usually for improvement
items.example: The law was reformed in 1998.
items.exampleCN: 该法律于 1998 年得到改革。

definition_zh: 过渡；转变；转型；过渡期
definition_en: the process of changing from one state, form, or activity to another
core_image: 闸门之间的一小段桥：从这头走到那头
scene: 毕业典礼结束，学生收拾宿舍行李，准备走向职场：秋天来了，山里的小镇正悄悄地完成从夏日旅游到滑雪季的 transition。
sceneCN: 这里 transition 是「过渡」（第 1 个义项：从一种状态到另一种状态）；句意是小镇由夏季旅游过渡到滑雪季。

collocations.zh: 从 A 到 B 的过渡

derivatives.zh: 由 transition 加 -al 构成，义为「过渡的；临时的」
由 transition 加 -ist 构成，义为「主张转型者」（罕用）
由动词加现在分词构成，义为「转型过程；身份过渡」

senses.title: A change from one state or form to another
senses.definition: the act of changing from one state, stage, or form into another
senses.definitionCN: 从一种状态、阶段或形式变为另一种
senses.example: The transition from school to work is never easy.
senses.exampleCN: 从学校到职场的过渡从来不易。
senses.why: The core image is the short bridge between two gates: you are leaving one and arriving at the other.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两道闸门之间的小桥：你既已离开一处，又正在抵达另一处。

senses.title: A period during which such change happens
senses.definition: a time during which a change of state is in progress
senses.definitionCN: 状态转变正在发生的时期
senses.example: The company set a two-year transition for the new system.
senses.exampleCN: 公司为新系统设置了两年过渡期。
senses.why: The bridge itself takes time to cross; that time is the transition.
senses.whyCN: 走完这座桥需要时间；这段时光就是过渡期。

senses.title: A smooth connection between pieces of writing or music
senses.definition: a passage connecting sections of text or music
senses.definitionCN: 连接文章或乐曲各部分的段落
senses.example: The essay needs a better transition between the two paragraphs.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章两段之间需要更好的衔接。
senses.why: Writers and composers build small bridges so their readers cross without stumbling.
senses.whyCN: 作者与作曲家搭起小桥，让读者顺畅走过。

intro.en: Transition comes from Latin transitio, a going across, from transire (to go across), built on trans- (across) and ire (to go).
intro.cn: transition 来自拉丁语 transitio「走过去」，动词 transire 由 trans-（跨越）与 ire（走）构成。

items.en: ire meant to go, a root also seen in exit and transit.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ire 意为「走」，也见于 exit、transit。

items.en: transire meant to go across or pass over.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transire 意为「跨过、经过」。

items.en: transitio named the passage between subjects in rhetoric.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 transitio 指修辞中的话题过渡。

items.en: Borrowed with meanings of passing and change.
items.cn: 16 世纪借入英语，意为经过与改变。

items.en: Now spans personal, political, and technical changes.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖个人、政治与技术领域的转变。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to transition, and words in the change field.
note.cn: 与 transition 形近音近的词，以及同属转变义场的词。

entries.definition: an act of doing business
entries.definitionCN: 交易，与 transition 只差词根：ire 走过去，agere 办妥

entries.definition: the act of passing through
entries.definitionCN: 运输；通行，同根词 transire 的另一派生

entries.definition: lasting only a short time
entries.definitionCN: 短暂的；瞬间的，同源形容词

entries.definition: to become different
a change of form or use
entries.definitionCN: 转变；换算，强调形式的转换

entries.definition: a change of position or direction
entries.definitionCN: 变动；转移，偏方向与重心

entries.definition: a complete change of form
entries.definitionCN: 彻底变形，强调结果的全新

normalIntro.en: Remember ire, to go: a transition is a change you walk across.
normalIntro.cn: 记住词根 ire「走」：transition 是要走过去的变化。

normal.en: trans- (across) + ition (going)
normal.cn: 跨过去（trans）+ 走（ition）＝过渡

normal.en: transit, transitory are the same family
normal.cn: transit（通行）、transitory（短暂）同属一词族

normal.en: collocation: smooth transition
normal.cn: 常用搭配 smooth transition（平稳过渡）

normal.en: transition from A to B
normal.cn: 从 A 到 B 的过渡是固定句式

normal.en: watch out for transaction
normal.cn: 勿与 transaction（交易）混淆

abstract.en: A narrow bridge between two open gates
abstract.cn: 两道敞开的闸门之间的一座窄桥

abstract.en: A chrysalis hanging: neither caterpillar nor butterfly yet
abstract.cn: 悬在枝头的蛹：既非毛虫也非蝴蝶

abstract.en: A single chord sliding the song into a new key
abstract.cn: 一个和弦让歌曲滑进新调

examples.en: The country is going through a difficult economic transition.
examples.cn: 该国正经历艰难的经济转型。

examples.en: Good writing needs smooth transitions between paragraphs.
examples.cn: 好文章需要段落间顺畅的衔接。

examples.en: The bridge will close during the transition to a new route.
examples.cn: 路线切换期间大桥将封闭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹日行」——过渡期里每天踹着自己往前走一脚：踹（trans）日（ire 走）行 → transition，走着过桥的意思。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（跨越）+ ire（走）→ transire「走过去」→ transitio「跨越之行走」：一切过渡都是走过去的那一段。

sensesIntro.en: From walking across, the word covers state changes, the time they take, and the joins in art.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「走过去」延伸到状态转变、转变所需的时间与艺术中的衔接。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the short bridge between two gates
core.cn: 核心意象：两道闸门之间的一座小桥

branches.en: the change itself between states
branches.cn: 状态之间的转变本身

branches.en: the time spent changing
branches.cn: 转变所占用的时间

branches.en: the written or musical join
branches.cn: 文章或乐曲的衔接

branches.en: you cannot rush the bridge; it has its own length
branches.cn: 桥有其长度，过渡不能硬赶

branches.en: both roads and texts need smooth crossings
branches.cn: 路与文章都需要顺畅的过渡

intro.en: Transition shows the Latin pair trans- + ire, shared by transit and transitory.
