intro.cn: transition 呈现了拉丁语 trans- 加 ire 的组合，与 transit、transitory 同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin ire also gave exit, circuit, ambition (going around), and perish (going through).
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ire 还派生了 exit、circuit、ambition（四处奔走）与 perish（走完全程而消亡）。

items.example: transition, transmit
items.exampleCN: transition、transmit 中的前缀

items.example: the root of transit
items.exampleCN: transit 的词根

items.example: source of transition
items.exampleCN: transition 的来源

items.example: transition
items.exampleCN: 过渡

items.meaning: the passing of goods or people
items.example: in transit
items.exampleCN: 在运输途中

items.example: transitory fame
items.exampleCN: 转瞬即逝的名声

items.example: emergency exit
items.exampleCN: 紧急出口

items.example: a circuit court
items.exampleCN: 巡回法庭

latinEntries.meaning: a going across, a passing over

definition_zh: 翻译；译成；转化；解释；被译成
definition_en: to express words in another language, or to change something into a different form or result
core_image: 一句话从一个人嘴里出来，落到另一个人嘴里时换了一副字
scene: 餐桌上，一位老奶奶只会方言，孙女把她的吩咐一句句换成普通话讲给客人听。She translated her grandmother’s story for the guests.
sceneCN: 这里 translate 是「把话译成另一种语言」（第 1 个义项：口头或书面翻译）；句意为她把奶奶讲的故事译给客人听。话从一张嘴搬到另一张嘴的画面正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ion 构成名词，义为「翻译；译文」
动词加 -or 构成，义为「译者；翻译员」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可译的」

senses.title: To express in another language
senses.definition: to say or write words again in a different language
senses.definitionCN: 用另一种语言把话语或文字重新表达
senses.example: She translates poetry from Japanese into English.
senses.exampleCN: 她把日本诗歌译成英文。
senses.why: The Latin latus means carried, so to translate is to carry a meaning across into another tongue.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 latus 意为「被搬运」，所以 translate 就是把意义搬到另一种语言里。

senses.title: To turn into another form or result
senses.definition: to change something into a different form or practical result
senses.definitionCN: 把某物变成另一种形式或实际结果
senses.example: Good plans rarely translate into good results easily.
senses.exampleCN: 好计划很少能轻易变成好结果。
senses.why: Once meaning can be carried across, any conversion from one state to another fits the same verb.
senses.whyCN: 既然意义能被搬过去，那么任何从一种状态到另一种的转换都能用这个动词。

senses.title: To explain or understand in one’s own terms
senses.definition: to explain or understand something in a way one can grasp
senses.definitionCN: 用自己能把握的方式解释或理解某物
senses.example: He translated her silence as agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 他把她的沉默理解为同意。
senses.why: Readers carry a text into their own frame, and that carrying is also a translation.
senses.whyCN: 读者把文本搬进自己的框架，这一次搬运同样是翻译。

senses.title: To be capable of being translated
senses.definition: to be able to be put into another language with its meaning kept
senses.definitionCN: 能被译成另一种语言而意义不失
senses.example: This joke does not translate well.
senses.exampleCN: 这个笑话一译就走味。
senses.why: When the load cannot be carried without damage, we say the thing does not translate.
senses.whyCN: 当那担货搬过去必然受损时，我们就说这个东西译不好。

senses.title: To move a bishop to another see
senses.definition: to move a bishop from one diocese to another
senses.definitionCN: 把主教从一个教区调到另一个
senses.example: He was translated to a northern diocese.
senses.exampleCN: 他被调任到北方一个教区。
senses.why: This is the oldest English sense: a holy man is carried to a new seat.
senses.whyCN: 这是英语里最古老的义项：把神职人员搬到新的座位。

intro.en: The verb comes from Latin translatus, the past participle of transferre, to carry across.
intro.cn: 这个动词来自拉丁语 translatus，是 transferre（搬运过去）的过去分词。

items.en: Ferre means to carry, and its participle latus means carried, born, or brought.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ferre 意为搬运，其分词 latus 意为被搬、被承载。

items.en: Translatus is a carrying across, used of moving goods, of people, and later of meaning.
items.cn: translatus 是一次搬运过去，先用于货物与人，后用于意义。

items.en: Old French translater gives English the verb with the sense of turning text into another tongue.
items.cn: 古法语 translater 把这个动词传入英语，含「把文本换成另一种语言」之义。

items.en: English uses it from the fourteenth century for rendering texts, and later for other conversions.
items.cn: 英语从十四世纪用它指译文本，后来又扩及其他转换。

items.en: Biology and business extend it to protein synthesis and to results.
items.cn: 生物学与商业又把它扩展到蛋白质合成与成效。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -lat- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other verbs about rendering and explaining.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -lat- 词干，近义组汇集表示转换与解释的其他动词。

entries.definition: the act or result of rendering into another language
a person who translates
to move something to another place
to connect one thing with another
to express something in another form
to explain the meaning of something
to restate in other words
to change into another form

normalIntro.en: The -lat- inside the word is the Latin participle carried, and it ties the whole family together.
normalIntro.cn: 词中的 -lat- 就是拉丁语分词「被搬运」，把整个词族连在一起。

normal.en: Trans- is across and latus is carried, so translate is to carry meaning across.
normal.cn: trans- 是跨过，latus 是被搬运，所以 translate 就是把意义搬过去。

normal.en: Translation is the act or the text, translator is the person.
normal.cn: translation 是行为或文本，translator 是人。

normal.en: Transfer and relate are cousins, built on the same carried root.
normal.cn: transfer 与 relate 是表亲，建在同一个「搬运」词根上。

normal.en: Ideas can be translated into action, which is the figurative use.
normal.cn: 想法可以 translate into action，这是比喻用法。

normal.en: A joke that does not translate loses its point on the way across.
normal.cn: 译不通的笑话在搬运途中丢了意思。

abstract.en: Picture one sentence stepping off a boat on the other shore.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话在彼岸下船。

abstract.en: Hear it land in another alphabet, the meaning still whole.
abstract.cn: 听它落在另一套字母里，意思仍然完整。

abstract.en: Then picture the same sentence as a plan, landing as a deed.
abstract.cn: 再把这同一句话想成计划，落地时成了行动。

examples.en: He translates French novels for a living.
examples.cn: 他靠翻译法国小说为生。

examples.en: Their enthusiasm did not translate into votes.
examples.cn: 他们的热情并没有变成选票。

examples.en: I translated his silence as a refusal.
examples.cn: 我把他的沉默理解为拒绝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯雷特」——把话穿过一条街，送到雷特先生的耳朵里。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ latus（ferre「搬运」的过去分词），动词 transferre 经古法语 translater 进入英语；同族有 transfer、relate

sensesIntro.en: The senses all describe carrying something across a gap: a language, a state, or a silence.
sensesIntro.cn: 所有义项都描述把某物跨过一道距离搬过去：跨语言、跨状态，或跨过一段沉默。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sentence leaving one mouth and landing in another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句话从一张嘴出来，落进另一张嘴。

branches.en: The language pair: rendering a text, and failing to render it well.
branches.cn: 语言一对：把文本译出，或译不好。

branches.en: The conversion sense, where a plan becomes a result.
branches.cn: 转化义：计划变成结果。

branches.en: The reading sense, where a silence is carried into meaning.
branches.cn: 阅读义：沉默被搬成意义。

branches.en: The church sense, where a bishop is carried to a new seat.
branches.cn: 教会义：主教被搬到新的座位。

branches.en: The plain translating sense, where words are the load.
branches.cn: 朴素翻译义：那担货是词语。

intro.en: The verb is a Latin prefix of crossing plus the participle of the verb to carry.
intro.cn: 这个动词是表示跨越的拉丁前缀加上「搬运」动词的分词。

latinIntro.en: Ferre and its participle latus lie behind a very large English family.
latinIntro.cn: ferre 及其分词 latus 支撑着一个非常庞大的英语词族。

items.example: Transit goods pass through a country.
items.exampleCN: transit 的货物过境一个国家。

items.example: Latus underlies translate and relate.
items.exampleCN: latus 支撑着 translate 与 relate。

items.example: Transfer the file to a disk.
items.exampleCN: 把文件转到磁盘上。

items.example: Relate the result to the cause.
items.exampleCN: 把结果与原因联系起来。

items.example: The footnote refers to page ten.
items.exampleCN: 脚注指向第十页。

items.example: She offered him a seat.
items.exampleCN: 她给他让了个座。

items.example: They translate poetry every winter.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年冬天都译诗。

items.example: Translate gives translator.
items.exampleCN: translate 加它成为 translator。

items.example: Translate gives translatable.
items.exampleCN: translate 加它成为 translatable。

definition_zh: 传送；发射；传输；传播（疾病、情感）
definition_en: to send out signals, to pass something such as a disease or a feeling to others, or to send power through a wire
core_image: 山顶天线在雨里一闪一闪地把声音发向云层
scene: 雨夜的广播站，天线塔顶端的红灯一亮一暗。The station transmits news to the whole coast every hour.
sceneCN: 这里 transmit 是「发射；传送」（第 1 个义项：把信号发出去）；句意为这家电台每小时向整个海岸发送一次新闻。雨里一闪一闪的天线，就是这个词的形象。

derivatives.zh: 由 transmit 加 -ssion 构成，义为「传送；传输」
由 transmit 加 -er 构成，义为「发射机；传送者」
由 transmit 加 -able 构成，义为「可传送的；可传播的」

senses.title: Sending a signal out
senses.definition: to send out an electronic signal such as radio waves or a picture
senses.definitionCN: 发出无线电波、图像等电子信号
senses.example: The station transmits news to the whole coast every hour.
senses.exampleCN: 这家电台每小时向整个海岸发送一次新闻。
senses.why: Latin mittere means to send, and trans adds the direction, so the verb is simply to send across.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 mittere 意为送，trans 补上方向，于是这个动词就是「送过去」。

senses.title: Passing on illness
senses.definition: to pass an infection or a parasite from one living thing to another
senses.definitionCN: 把感染或寄生虫从一种生物传给另一种
senses.example: Mosquitoes can transmit several dangerous fevers.
senses.exampleCN: 蚊子能传播好几种危险的发热病。
senses.why: When a mosquito carries a germ to a new body, it does exactly what a wire does with a signal.
senses.whyCN: 当蚊子把病菌带到新的身体里，它做的事和导线对待信号完全一样。

senses.title: Carrying heat or force
senses.definition: to allow heat, sound, or force to pass through a material
senses.definitionCN: 让热、声或力通过某种材料传过
senses.example: Metal transmits heat faster than wood.
senses.exampleCN: 金属导热比木头快。
senses.why: Physics borrowed the everyday verb because energy also crosses from one place to another.
senses.whyCN: 物理学借用了这个日常动词，因为能量也同样从一处走到另一处。

senses.title: Passing on a feeling
senses.definition: to make other people feel the emotion you feel
senses.definitionCN: 让别人感受到你所感受的情绪
senses.example: Her calm voice transmitted confidence to the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 她平静的声音把信心传给了整支队伍。
senses.why: A feeling can travel from one mind to another, so the word reaches beyond wires and bodies.
senses.whyCN: 情绪能从一个心灵传到另一个心灵，于是这个词越过了导线与身体。

intro.en: Transmit is the Latin verb transmittere, to send across, taken into English with its two parts still visible.
intro.cn: transmit 是拉丁语动词 transmittere（送过去）原样进入英语，两部分仍然清晰可见。

items.en: Mittere, to send, is one of the busiest verbs of Latin motion.
items.cn: mittere（送）是拉丁语中最常用的运动动词之一。

items.en: Transmittere meant to send a thing over or through, from a hand to a place.
items.cn: transmittere 意为把东西送过或送穿，从一只手到一处地方。

items.en: French kept transmettre, used for handing on property as well as objects.
items.cn: 法语保留 transmettre，既用于递交物品也用于转让财产。

items.en: English took transmit first for the passing on of disease and of rights.
items.cn: 英语最初用 transmit 表示疾病与权利的传递。

items.en: Telegraph and radio gave the verb its modern electronic sense.
items.cn: 电报与无线电赋予这个动词现代的电子含义。

note.en: The first group shows forms of the same verb, the second shows other verbs of sending and spreading.
note.cn: 第一组是同一动词的各种形式，第二组是其他表示发送与扩散的动词。

entries.definition: The act of sending or passing on.
A device that sends out signals.
Sent out or passed on in the past.
To send out a programme to many listeners.
To carry or make a feeling understood.
To move over a wider area.

normalIntro.en: Transmit keeps the trans of crossing and the mit of sending, and doubles its t before endings.
normalIntro.cn: transmit 保留 trans（跨越）与 mit（送），在加词尾前要把 t 双写。

normal.en: Mit is the same root as in submit and admit.
normal.cn: mit 与 submit、admit 里的词根相同。

normal.en: The past tense doubles the last letter: transmitted.
normal.cn: 过去式双写末字母：transmitted。

normal.en: The stress falls on the second syllable: transMIT.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：transMIT。

normal.en: A transmitter does the sending, a transmission is the sending itself.
normal.cn: transmitter 执行发送，transmission 是发送这件事。

normal.en: Radio waves transmit without any wire at all.
normal.cn: 无线电波根本不需要导线就能传送。

abstract.en: A red light blinking on a tower at night.
abstract.cn: 夜里塔上闪烁的一点红光。

abstract.en: A word leaving one mouth and arriving in many ears.
abstract.cn: 一句话离开一张嘴，落进许多只耳朵。

abstract.en: Heat moving quietly along a metal spoon.
abstract.cn: 热安静地沿着金属勺子移动。

examples.en: The tower transmits the signal to ships far out at sea.
examples.cn: 这座塔把信号传送给远在海上的船只。

examples.en: Some insects transmit disease when they bite.
examples.cn: 有些昆虫叮咬时会传播疾病。

examples.en: Copper transmits electricity better than iron.
examples.cn: 铜导电比铁好。

dict_mnemonic.text: trans（越过）＋ mit（送）——把信号送越距离，就是发射传送。

root: 拉丁语 transmittere，trans（越过）＋ mittere（送），本义「送过去」；同族词有 transmission、transmitter、transmittable。

sensesIntro.en: The electronic signal comes first, then disease, then heat and force, then feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是电子信号，再是疾病，然后是热与力，最后是情感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tower light blinking in rain.
core.cn: 核心意象：雨里闪烁的塔灯。

branches.en: The signal branch: waves leaving the antenna.
branches.cn: 信号分支：离开天线的波。

branches.en: The illness branch: germs carried by a bite.
branches.cn: 疾病分支：被叮咬带走的病菌。

branches.en: The material branch: heat allowed to pass through.
branches.cn: 材料分支：允许热穿过的物体。

branches.en: The feeling branch: calm travelling to others.
branches.cn: 情感分支：平静传给他人。

branches.en: The unseen branch: nothing visible ever moves.
branches.cn: 无形分支：看不见任何东西真正移动。

intro.en: Transmit is trans plus the Latin root mit, and it gains -er, -able and -ssion in its family.
intro.cn: transmit 是 trans 加拉丁词根 mit，词族中再加 -er、-able 与 -ssion。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root mittere, to send, appears in many English verbs, four of which are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 mittere（送）出现在许多英语动词中，下面列出其中四条。

items.example: The prefix sets the direction of the sending.
items.exampleCN: 前缀确定发送的方向。

items.example: The root supplies the meaning of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 词根提供动词的核心义。

items.example: It forms transmitter, the sending device.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transmitter，发送装置。

items.example: It forms transmittable, able to be passed on.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transmittable，可被传递的。

items.example: The sending goes downward under authority.
items.exampleCN: 送出朝下，置于权威之下。

items.meaning: to send toward, hence let in
items.example: The sending goes toward the inside.
items.exampleCN: 送出朝向内部。

items.example: Per means through, so the way is open.
items.exampleCN: per 意为穿过，于是道路敞开。

items.example: Com means together, so the act binds both sides.
items.exampleCN: com 意为共同，于是这个行为把双方绑在一起。

definition_zh: 透明的；清澈的；易懂的；公开的
definition_en: clear enough to see through, easy to understand, or open for everyone to see
core_image: 清晨的窗玻璃干净得像不存在，树枝的影子直接落在桌面
scene: 雪后的早晨，窗玻璃擦得发亮，外面的鸟落在枝上。The lake was so transparent that we saw stones on the bottom.
sceneCN: 这里 transparent 是「透明的；清澈的」（第 1 个义项：能看清后面东西的）；句意为湖水清澈得能看见水底的石头。擦得很亮的窗和清得见底的水，都是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 transparent 加 -cy 构成，义为「透明；透明度」
由 transparent 加 -ly 构成，义为「透明地；显然地」
由 semi-（半）与 transparent 复合，义为「半透明的」

senses.title: Seeing straight through
senses.definition: clear enough for light to pass through, so objects behind can be seen
senses.definitionCN: 足够清澈让光线通过，因而能看见后面的物体
senses.example: The lake was so transparent that we saw stones on the bottom.
senses.exampleCN: 湖水清澈得能看见水底的石头。
senses.why: Latin trans, through, plus parere, to appear, means letting light appear through the body.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 trans（穿过）加 parere（显现），意为让光穿过物体显现出来。

senses.title: Water you can look into
senses.definition: used of water that is free of mud or cloudiness
senses.definitionCN: 用于形容水中没有泥沙或浑浊物
senses.example: Children watched the transparent stream flow over the pebbles.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们看着清澈的小溪流过卵石。
senses.why: Clear water is the everyday picture of the whole idea, so the adjective drifted into it naturally.
senses.whyCN: 清水是这一概念的日常画面，形容词自然就延伸到了这里。

senses.title: Easy to follow
senses.definition: expressed so simply that nobody can misunderstand it
senses.definitionCN: 表达得简单明了，不会被误解
senses.example: Her explanation was transparent even to the beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 即使是初学者也能听懂她的解释。
senses.why: If nothing hides the meaning, the words are transparent in the same way glass is.
senses.whyCN: 如果没有任何东西遮住含义，那么这些词就像玻璃一样透明。

senses.title: Open to inspection
senses.definition: used of rules or actions that anyone may examine and judge
senses.definitionCN: 用于形容任何人可以查看与评判的规则或行为
senses.example: The committee promised a transparent selection process.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会承诺采用公开透明的选拔流程。
senses.why: Modern politics borrowed the glass image for institutions that have nothing to hide.
senses.whyCN: 现代政治借用了玻璃的意象，形容没什么可隐藏的机构。

intro.en: Transparent comes from the Latin verb transparere, to show through, made of trans, through, and parere, to appear.
intro.cn: transparent 来自拉丁语动词 transparere（透出），由 trans（穿过）与 parere（显现）组成。

items.en: Parere meant to come into sight or be visible, the root of appear.
items.cn: parere 意为出现、可见，是 appear 的词根。

items.en: Transparens described bodies that let light pass and show what lies behind.
items.cn: transparens 形容能让光透过、显出背后事物的物体。

items.en: French borrowed it in the sense of showing light through a material.
items.cn: 法语借入时指让光透过材料显现出来。

items.en: English extended the adjective from glass and water to arguments and excuses.
items.cn: 英语把这个形容词从玻璃和水扩展到论证与借口。

items.en: Public life adopted the word for open government and honest rules.
items.cn: 公共生活借用它来指开放的政府与诚实的规则。

note.en: The first group shares the par, to appear, stem, the second holds other words about clarity.
note.cn: 第一组共享 par（显现）词干，第二组收其他表示清晰的词。

entries.definition: The quality of being clear or open.
In a clear and open way.
Clearly visible or seeming true.
Easy to see through or understand.
Letting light through without showing shapes clearly.
So thin or clear that shapes show through.

normalIntro.en: Transparent can be read as trans plus parent: something you can see straight through to the others behind it.
normalIntro.cn: transparent 可以读成 trans 加 parent：你能一眼看穿它，看到后面的东西。

normal.en: Par is the appear root of apparent and appear.
normal.cn: par 是 apparent 与 appear 里表示「显现」的词根。

normal.en: Trans moves across, so light moves straight through.
normal.cn: trans 是穿过，于是光笔直透过去。

normal.en: The noun ends in -cy: transparency.
normal.cn: 名词以 -cy 结尾：transparency。

normal.en: Stress falls on the second syllable: transPARent.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：transPARent。

normal.en: A transparent excuse is one that hides nothing, including the truth.
normal.cn: transparent excuse 是不藏东西的借口，包括不藏真相。

abstract.en: A window so clean that the tree seems to stand indoors.
abstract.cn: 窗户干净得树仿佛长在屋里。

abstract.en: A glass of water on white paper, almost invisible.
abstract.cn: 白纸上一杯几乎看不见的水。

abstract.en: A sentence that lets the meaning through without a shadow.
abstract.cn: 一句让意思毫无阴影地穿过的话。

examples.en: The lid is transparent, so you can watch the seeds grow.
examples.cn: 盖子透明，所以你能看到种子发芽。

examples.en: The river runs transparent over smooth grey stones.
examples.cn: 河水清澈地流过光滑的灰石。

examples.en: Their rules of choosing members are written in a transparent way.
examples.cn: 他们选择成员的规则写得清楚透明。

dict_mnemonic.text: trans（穿过）＋ parent（显现）——光穿过它还能显出后面，就是透明的。

root: 拉丁语 transparere（透出），trans（穿过）＋parere（显现、出现），词干 par- 也见于 apparent、appear；同族词有 transparency、transparently。

sensesIntro.en: Glass first, then clear water, then clear words, then open institutions.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是玻璃，再是清水，然后是明白的话语，最后是公开的机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a window so clean it almost vanishes.
core.cn: 核心意象：干净得几乎消失的窗。

branches.en: The glass branch: light passes and objects appear.
branches.cn: 玻璃分支：光穿过，物体显现。

branches.en: The water branch: nothing cloudy blocks the view.
branches.cn: 水分支：没有浑物挡住视线。

branches.en: The language branch: meaning shows through the words.
branches.cn: 语言分支：意思透过词显现。

branches.en: The institution branch: nothing is kept out of sight.
branches.cn: 机构分支：没有东西被藏起来。

branches.en: The image branch: glass and sentences share one picture.
branches.cn: 意象分支：玻璃与句子共用同一幅画。

intro.en: Transparent combines the Latin prefix trans with the stem par, to appear, and adds -ent as an adjective ending.
intro.cn: transparent 把拉丁前缀 trans 与词干 par（显现）结合，并以 -ent 作形容词结尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin parere, to appear, also gives apparent and the verb appear, all built on the same stem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 parere（显现）还生出 apparent 与动词 appear，都建在同一词干上。

items.example: It tells us the light passes through.
items.exampleCN: 它告诉我们光穿了过去。

items.example: The stem gives the idea of showing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干给出显现的意思。

items.example: It makes the stem an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把词干变成形容词。

items.example: It forms transparency, the state of being clear.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transparency，透明的状态。

items.example: It forms transparently, in a clear way.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 transparently，透明地。

items.example: The same stem appears here without trans.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干在这里出现，只是没有 trans。

items.example: The verb keeps the plain sense of showing.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词保留了显现的朴素含义。

items.example: It forms semi-transparent, partly see-through.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 semi-transparent，部分透明的。

definition_zh: 蒸腾作用；植物体内水分经气孔散失到空气的过程
definition_en: the loss of water vapour from plants, mainly through the stomata
core_image: 根吸上来的水走完整株植物，最后从叶面变成水汽散进空气
scene: 正午的玉米地叶片卷起，根吸上来的水大部分并没有留在植株里。Most of that water leaves the field by transpiration.
sceneCN: 这里 transpiration 指「植物经气孔散失水汽的过程」（第 1 个义项：作为整株植物的失水过程）；句意：那些水大部分以蒸腾作用离开了这块田。

pos.zh: 蒸腾作用（植物失水，不可数）
散发；蒸发（一般意义的水汽散出）

derivatives.zh: 蒸腾；发生；泄露
蒸腾作用的
蒸散（蒸发与蒸腾之和）
可蒸腾的

senses.title: Water loss from plants
senses.titleCN: 植物失水：水从叶面变成水汽
senses.definition: the loss of water vapour from a plant, mainly through its stomata
senses.definitionCN: 植物主要经气孔散失水汽的过程
senses.example: Most of that water leaves the field by transpiration.
senses.exampleCN: 那些水大部分以蒸腾作用离开了这块田。
senses.why: The plant is a wick: water enters at the roots, moves up, and leaves as vapour at the leaves.
senses.whyCN: 植物就是一根烛芯：水从根进、往上走，最后在叶片以水汽离开。

senses.title: The pull
senses.titleCN: 蒸腾拉力：水柱被向上拽
senses.definition: the tension that the loss of vapour creates, drawing water up the plant
senses.definitionCN: 水汽散失造成的拉力，把水沿植物体向上拉
senses.example: Transpiration pull lifts water to the tallest leaves.
senses.exampleCN: 蒸腾拉力把水送到最高的叶片。
senses.why: Every litre that leaves the leaf pulls another litre up behind it, so loss and lift are one mechanism.
senses.whyCN: 每从叶片走掉一升水，就往上拽进另一升，于是失水与提升是同一套机制。

senses.title: Rate
senses.titleCN: 速率：单位时间失去多少水
senses.definition: the measured rate at which a plant loses water vapour
senses.definitionCN: 单位时间内散失水汽的速率
senses.example: They measured transpiration with a potometer.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用蒸腾计测蒸腾速率。
senses.why: Once the process is named, instruments can give it a number, and the word comes to mean that number.
senses.whyCN: 过程一旦有了名字，仪器就能给它一个数，这个词也随之指那个数。

senses.title: Cooling
senses.definition: the cooling of a leaf that the evaporation of water produces
senses.definitionCN: 水分蒸发给叶片带来的降温
senses.example: Transpiration keeps the leaf below air temperature.
senses.exampleCN: 蒸腾让叶温低于气温。
senses.why: Evaporation takes heat with it, so the same loss that costs water also saves the leaf from overheating.
senses.whyCN: 蒸发会带走热量，于是这份失水在耗水的同时，也让叶片免于过热。

senses.title: Stomatal control
senses.titleCN: 气孔调控：开合决定失水快慢
senses.definition: the regulation of water loss by the opening and closing of the stomata
senses.definitionCN: 气孔开合对失水快慢的调控
senses.example: Transpiration stops when the stomata close at midday.
senses.exampleCN: 正午气孔关闭时，蒸腾就停止了。
senses.why: The pores are the tap, and the word covers whatever flow the tap allows.
senses.whyCN: 气孔是龙头，这个词覆盖龙头允许的那股流量。

senses.title: Water-use ratio
senses.titleCN: 蒸腾比：造一克干物质要用多少水
senses.definition: the ratio of water lost to dry matter gained
senses.definitionCN: 失水量与所得干物质之比
senses.example: A low transpiration ratio marks a thrifty crop.
senses.exampleCN: 蒸腾比低说明这种作物省水。
senses.why: Farmers compare outputs, so the process becomes a ratio of cost to yield.
senses.whyCN: 农人要比较产出，于是这个过程变成一个成本与产量的比值。

senses.title: General vapor release
senses.titleCN: 一般散发：任何表面散出水汽
senses.definition: the release of water vapour from any surface, not only from plants
senses.definitionCN: 任何表面散出水汽，不限于植物
senses.example: Transpiration from the wet soil continued all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 湿土散出的水汽持续了一下午。
senses.why: The word began as a general term for giving off vapour, and the botanical sense narrowed one part of it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初泛指散出水汽，植物义只是把其中一部分收窄了。

senses.title: Sweat and exhalation
senses.titleCN: 人体散发：出汗与呼出水汽
senses.definition: the giving off of moisture through the skin or the breath, an older medical use
senses.definitionCN: 经皮肤或呼吸散出水分，属较早的医学用法
senses.example: Old medical texts speak of transpiration through the skin.
senses.exampleCN: 较早的医学文献说到经皮肤的散发。
senses.why: Before it belonged to botany, the word described the body's own invisible moisture, and medicine kept that sense.
senses.whyCN: 在归植物学之前，这个词描述身体自己看不见的水分，医学保留了这层意思。

senses.title: Vapour flux in the water cycle
senses.titleCN: 水汽通量：区域尺度上的失水
senses.definition: the flux of water vapour from a region, summed over its vegetation
senses.definitionCN: 某一区域植被总体散出的水汽通量
senses.example: Transpiration returns a large share of rainfall to the air.
senses.exampleCN: 蒸腾把降水的很大一部分送回空中。
senses.why: Scale the wick from one plant to a catchment and the word becomes a term in the water budget.
senses.whyCN: 把这根烛芯从一株植物放大到一个集水区，这个词就成了水量收支里的一个项。

intro.en: Transpiration joins Latin trans- 'across' to spirare 'to breathe', literally 'a breathing through'.
intro.cn: transpiration 把拉丁 trans-「穿过」与 spirare「呼吸」连起来，字面是「透过去呼吸」。

items.en: Latin spirare meant 'to breathe, to blow', and it also gives spirit, inspire and expire.
items.cn: 拉丁 spirare 意为「呼吸、吹」，它也是 spirit、inspire、expire 的来源。

items.en: Transpirare meant 'to breathe through, to emit vapour', built with the prefix trans- 'across, through'.
items.cn: transpirare 意为「透过去呼吸、散出水汽」，由前缀 trans-「穿过」构成。

items.en: English adopted the noun in the seventeenth century for the giving off of invisible moisture, including from the body.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入这个名词，指散出看不见的水分，包括身体散出的。

items.en: Nineteenth-century plant physiology narrowed the word to water loss through the stomata, the sense that now dominates.
items.cn: 十九世纪的植物生理学把这个词收窄为经气孔失水，这一义项如今占主导。

items.en: Twentieth-century hydrology extended it again, to vapour fluxes summed over whole regions.
items.cn: 二十世纪的水文学又把它扩展为整个区域的水汽通量。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the Latin roots are certain, but the first English use is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代）：拉丁词根确定，但英语首次使用的年代只有约数。

note.en: Group one separates the same-root breathing words from the one that means sweat; group two holds the water-loss terms it is confused with.
note.cn: 第一组区分同源的「呼吸」词与表示出汗的那个词；第二组列出常被混淆的失水术语。

entries.definition: The verb: to give off vapour, and informally to become known.
entries.definitionCN: 动词：散出水汽；口语里也指事情逐渐为人所知。

entries.definition: Per- 'through' plus spirare: sweat, the body's own moisture.
entries.definitionCN: per-「穿过」加 spirare：汗，身体自己的水分。

entries.definition: Re- plus spirare: breathing and the release of energy from sugar.
entries.definitionCN: re- 加 spirare：呼吸，以及从糖中释放能量。

entries.definition: In- 'into' plus spirare: drawing breath, and the figurative breath of an idea.
entries.definitionCN: in-「进入」加 spirare：吸气，以及想法带来的那口气。

entries.definition: Water turning to vapour from any surface; transpiration is its living-plant case.
entries.definitionCN: 水从任何表面变成水汽；蒸腾是它在活植物身上的情形。

entries.definition: The release of liquid water drops at leaf edges, not vapour.
entries.definitionCN: 叶缘释放液态水滴，不是水汽。

entries.definition: The slow release of sap or fluid from a wound or a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 汁液或液体从伤口或表面缓慢渗出。

entries.definition: Evaporation from soil plus transpiration from plants, added together.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤蒸发与植物蒸腾相加的总量。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the Latin pieces and the real physiology, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想用拉丁部件与真实生理过程，不编顺口溜。

normal.en: trans- 'through' + spirare 'to breathe': breathing through the leaf.
normal.cn: trans-「穿过」加 spirare「呼吸」：透过叶片呼吸。

normal.en: The family: transpire, transpiratory, evapotranspiration, perspiration.
normal.cn: 同族：transpire、transpiratory、evapotranspiration、perspiration。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: rate of transpiration, transpiration stream, transpiration pull.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：蒸腾速率、蒸腾流、蒸腾拉力。

normal.en: One wick, two jobs: it lifts water and it cools the leaf.
normal.cn: 一根烛芯，两件活：把水提上去，把叶子降温。

normal.en: Compare with perspiration: one is the plant's breath, one is the body's sweat.
normal.cn: 与 perspiration 对照：一个是植物的呼吸，一个是身体的汗。

abstract.en: Picture a tall tree as a straw that the air is slowly drinking from.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵高树是一根被空气慢慢吸饮的吸管。

abstract.en: Picture a field exhaling water into the sky all afternoon.
abstract.cn: 想象一块田整个下午都在向天空呼出水汽。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger where the water lost and the crop gained are written in one ratio.
abstract.cn: 想象一本账，把失去的水与得到的作物写成一个比值。

examples.en: Most of that water leaves the field by transpiration.
examples.cn: 那些水大部分以蒸腾作用离开了这块田。

examples.en: Transpiration pull lifts water to the tallest leaves.
examples.cn: 蒸腾拉力把水送到最高的叶片。

examples.en: Transpiration stops when the stomata close at midday.
examples.cn: 正午气孔关闭时，蒸腾就停止了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿过（trans）＋呼吸（spir）」——植物透过叶片向外呼气，把水汽送走

root: 拉丁 trans-「穿过」＋ spirare「呼吸」→ transpirare「透过去呼吸、散出水汽」。词根清晰；英语首见年代只有约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one current: water leaves the leaf, pulls more up behind it, is measured, cools the leaf, is controlled by the pores, becomes a farming ratio, widens to any surface, widens further to the body, and finally to a region's water budget.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一股水流展开：水离开叶片、把后面的水往上拽、被测量、给叶片降温、受气孔控制、变成农业比值，再扩到任何表面、扩到身体，最后扩到一个区域的水量收支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wick that carries water from the root to the air.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根把水从根送到空气里的烛芯。

branches.en: LOSS: the word first names the water leaving the plant.
branches.cn: 失去：这个词首先命名离开植物的水。

branches.en: TWO EFFECTS: the same loss lifts water and takes heat away.
branches.cn: 两个效果：同一份失水既提水又带走热。

branches.en: NUMBERS: rate and ratio turn the process into a quantity.
branches.cn: 数字：速率与比值把过程变成量。

branches.en: VALVE: the pores decide how fast the loss runs.
branches.cn: 阀门：气孔决定失水跑多快。

branches.en: WIDER: any surface, the body, a whole catchment.
branches.cn: 更广：任何表面、身体、整个集水区。

intro.en: Transpiration is Latin throughout: a Latin prefix, a Latin verb stem, and a Latin noun suffix.
intro.cn: transpiration 全部来自拉丁语：拉丁前缀、拉丁动词词干、拉丁名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin trans- 'through' and spirare 'to breathe' give transpirare; -ation, from -atio, names the action or its result.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 trans-「穿过」与 spirare「呼吸」给出 transpirare；-ation 来自 -atio，命名动作或结果。

items.example: It also appears in transport and translate.
items.exampleCN: 它也出现在 transport 与 translate 里。

items.example: The bare stem carries the breath.
items.exampleCN: 光秃的词干带着「呼吸」。

items.example: It makes a noun of the act.
items.exampleCN: 它把动作变成名词。

items.example: The English noun dates from the seventeenth century.
items.exampleCN: 这个英语名词始于十七世纪。

items.example: The verb is the base of the noun.
items.exampleCN: 动词是名词的基础。

items.example: The adjective marks relation.
items.exampleCN: 形容词标出关联。

items.example: Per- means 'through'.
items.exampleCN: per- 意为「穿过」。

items.example: Re- means 'again, back'.
items.exampleCN: re- 意为「再、回」。

items.example: In- means 'into'.
items.exampleCN: in- 意为「进入」。

items.example: The compound is a modern hydrology term.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是现代水文学术语。

latinEntries.structure: spirare, spiravi, spiratum (Latin verb, first conjugation)

definition_zh: 移植；移栽；迁移；搬迁
definition_en: to move a plant, organ, or piece of tissue from one place to another, or such a move
core_image: 一棵带土球的树被抬到新坑里，根须还带着旧地的泥
scene: 医院走廊里，护士推着装有捐献器官的保温箱快步走向手术室。The surgeons will transplant the donated kidney into the young patient.
sceneCN: 这里 transplant 是「移植」（第 1 个义项：把器官或组织移到另一个身体）；句意：外科医生将把这颗捐献的肾脏移植到这位年轻患者体内。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ation 构成名词，义为「移植；移植术」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可移植的」
动词加 -er 构成名词，义为「移栽者；移栽机」

senses.title: Moving an organ into another body
senses.definition: a medical operation that moves a healthy organ or tissue from one body to another
senses.definitionCN: 把健康的器官或组织从一个身体移到另一个身体的医疗手术
senses.example: The kidney transplant took five hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这台肾脏移植手术做了五个小时。
senses.why: Trans- means across and plantare means to plant, so the organ is planted in a new body.
senses.whyCN: trans- 意为「越过」，plantare 意为「栽种」，所以器官是被栽进一个新的身体。

senses.title: Replanting a plant in a new place
senses.definition: to dig up a growing plant and plant it again in another spot
senses.definitionCN: 把正在生长的植物挖起，再种到另一个地方
senses.example: We transplant the tomato seedlings in late spring.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在晚春移栽番茄幼苗。
senses.why: The oldest sense is agricultural: a plant is carried across and set into new soil.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项属于农业：植物被带过一段距离，安放进新的土壤。

senses.title: Moving people or things to a new place
senses.definition: to move a person, group, or thing to a different place or setting
senses.definitionCN: 把人、群体或事物移到另一个地方或环境
senses.example: The whole office was transplanted to a building near the river.
senses.exampleCN: 整个办公室被搬到了河边的一栋楼里。
senses.why: The agricultural image widens into any move that gives something a new setting.
senses.whyCN: 农业意象扩大为任何「给某物一个新环境」的迁移。

senses.title: A piece of living tissue moved by grafting
senses.definition: a piece of living tissue moved from one site to another, as in a skin graft
senses.definitionCN: 把一块活组织从一个部位移到另一个部位，如皮肤移植
senses.example: The burn unit used a skin transplant from the thigh of the patient.
senses.exampleCN: 烧伤科用患者大腿上的一块皮肤做了移植。
senses.why: A graft is a transplant on a small scale, moving living tissue from one site to another.
senses.whyCN: 移植物是小规模的移植，把活组织从一个部位挪到另一个部位。

intro.en: Transplant joins Latin trans, across, with plantare, to plant, and reaches English through French.
intro.cn: transplant 由拉丁语 trans（越过）与 plantare（栽种）组合，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Trans means across, beyond, or to the other side.
items.cn: trans 意为「越过、穿过、到另一边」。

items.en: Plantare means to plant, from planta, a shoot or the sole of the foot.
items.cn: plantare 意为栽种，源自 planta（幼苗；脚掌）。

items.en: Transplantare is recorded for planting something again elsewhere.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 transplantare 指把某物移种到别处。

items.en: French transplanter carries the word into gardening and, later, medicine.
items.cn: 法语 transplanter 把这个词带入园艺，后来又带入医学。

items.en: English transplant first names the moving of trees and plants.
items.cn: 英语 transplant 最初指搬运树木与植物。

items.en: Modern English extends transplant to organs, tissue, and whole communities.
items.cn: 现代英语把 transplant 扩展到器官、组织与整个群体。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the plantare family; the near-meaning group holds words for grafts, implants, and moves.
note.cn: 形近组收录 plantare 词族；近义组收录表示嫁接、植入与搬迁的词。

entries.definition: the act or operation of transplanting
able to be transplanted
to put a seed or young plant into the ground
entries.definitionCN: 把种子或幼苗种进土里

entries.definition: living tissue fixed onto another body or plant
entries.definitionCN: 嫁接到另一个身体或植物上的活组织

entries.definition: a device or tissue placed inside the body
entries.definitionCN: 植入体内的装置或组织

entries.definition: to move to another place

normalIntro.en: Transplant is a crossing plus a planting: something living is carried over and set down again.
normalIntro.cn: transplant 是「越过」加「栽种」：有生命的东西被带过去，再安放下来。

normal.en: Trans- means across and plantare means to plant, so a transplant crosses space to be planted.
normal.cn: trans- 意为「越过」，plantare 意为「栽种」，所以移植就是跨过一段距离去栽种。

normal.en: A heart transplant moves a healthy heart into a patient whose own heart is failing.
normal.cn: 心脏移植是把健康的心脏移入心脏衰竭的患者体内。

normal.en: Gardeners transplant seedlings when they outgrow the seed tray.
normal.cn: 幼苗长得超出育苗盘时，园丁就会移栽。

normal.en: The noun and the verb share one spelling: a transplant, to transplant.
normal.cn: 名词与动词拼写相同：a transplant 与 to transplant。

normal.en: Do not confuse transplant with implant: an implant is placed inside, a transplant arrives from another body.
normal.cn: 别把 transplant 与 implant 混淆：implant 是放入体内，transplant 来自另一个身体。

abstract.en: Picture a donor organ carried in a cold box into a new body.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗捐献器官装在冷藏箱里，被送进一个新的身体。

abstract.en: Imagine a seedling lifted with its roots and set into fresh soil.
abstract.cn: 想象一株幼苗连根被捧起，放进新鲜的土里。

abstract.en: Think of a whole office packed up and reopened in another city.
abstract.cn: 想象整个办公室被打包，在另一座城市重新开张。

examples.en: The hospital performed a heart transplant last night.
examples.cn: 这家医院昨晚做了一台心脏移植手术。

examples.en: Farmers transplant rice seedlings in early summer.
examples.cn: 农民在初夏移栽水稻秧苗。

examples.en: The transplanted tissue was accepted by the patient.
examples.cn: 移植的组织被患者接受了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「穿石烂种」——把苗穿过石缝硬栽下去，居然活了；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（越过、穿过）+ plantare（栽种，源自 planta「幼苗；脚掌」）→ 中世纪拉丁语 transplantare → 英语 transplant，核心义「连根带土挪到别处栽下」。

sensesIntro.en: Transplant moves from plants to organs, then widens to people and things, and finally narrows to a graft of tissue.
sensesIntro.cn: transplant 从植物移栽出发，转向器官移植，再扩大到人与物的迁移，最后收窄为组织移植。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tree with its root ball carried to a new pit.
core.cn: 核心意象：一棵带着土球的树被抬到新坑里。

branches.en: The organ sense is the medical branch.
branches.cn: 器官义项是医学分支。

branches.en: The plant sense is the oldest branch.
branches.cn: 植物义项是最古老的分支。

branches.en: The moving sense covers people and things.
branches.cn: 迁移义项覆盖人与物。

branches.en: The tissue sense is a small-scale graft.
branches.cn: 组织义项是小规模的移植。

branches.en: Both move living material into another body or site.
branches.cn: 两者都把活体材料移入另一个身体或部位。

intro.en: Transplant is built from the Latin prefix trans- and the verb plantare, with English derivatives around it.
intro.cn: transplant 由拉丁语前缀 trans- 与动词 plantare 构成，周围有一组英语派生词。

latinIntro.en: Latin trans means across, and plantare means to plant, from planta, a shoot.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trans 意为「越过」，plantare 意为「栽种」，源自 planta（幼苗）。

items.example: The prefix marks a crossing from one place to another.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出从一处到另一处的跨越。

items.example: Plantare supplies the planting action.
items.exampleCN: plantare 提供「栽种」的动作。

items.meaning: a shoot, a sprout, the sole
items.example: Planta is the noun behind plantare.
items.exampleCN: planta 是 plantare 背后的名词。

items.example: Transplantare joins the prefix and the verb.
items.exampleCN: transplantare 把前缀与动词连在一起。

items.example: French transplanter passes the compound to English.
items.exampleCN: 法语 transplanter 把这个复合词传给英语。

items.example: The verb transplant names the move.
items.exampleCN: 动词 transplant 指这一移动。

items.meaning: an organ or plant moved elsewhere
items.meaningCN: 移植的器官；移栽的植株
items.example: The noun transplant names the thing moved.
items.exampleCN: 名词 transplant 指被移走的东西。

items.example: The suffix -ation forms transplantation.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ation 构成 transplantation。

items.example: It turns a verb into a noun of action.
items.exampleCN: 它把动词变成表示动作的名词。

items.example: The suffix -able forms transplantable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成 transplantable。

definition_zh: 运输；交通；运输工具；运送；流放
definition_en: the movement of people or goods from one place to another, or the vehicles used for it
core_image: 一排货车排成长队，把成箱的货物从一座城搬到另一座城
scene: 公路上货车一辆接一辆，满载箱子朝港口开去。Public transport is the cheapest way to reach the harbor.
sceneCN: 这里 transport 是「交通、运输工具」（第 2 个义项：运送人或货的交通工具）；句意为公共交通是去港口最便宜的方式。货车长队正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ation 构成名词，义为「运输；运输系统」
动词加 -er 构成，义为「运输者；运输车辆」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可运输的」

senses.title: The moving of goods or people
senses.definition: the act of carrying people or goods from one place to another
senses.definitionCN: 把人或货物从一处运到另一处
senses.example: The transport of grain by rail is cheap.
senses.exampleCN: 用铁路运粮很便宜。
senses.why: The Latin portare means to carry, so transport is a carrying across a distance.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 portare 意为「搬运」，所以 transport 就是跨距离的搬运。

senses.title: A system or means of travel
senses.definition: the system of vehicles, roads, and routes used for travelling
senses.definitionCN: 用于出行的车辆、道路与路线的整套体系
senses.example: The city has excellent public transport.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市公共交通很好。
senses.why: When the carrying becomes a regular service, the system itself takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 当搬运变成固定的服务，整套系统本身就承接了这个名字。

senses.title: A vehicle for troops or goods
senses.definition: a ship, aircraft, or lorry used to carry soldiers or supplies
senses.definitionCN: 用来运送士兵或物资的船、飞机或卡车
senses.example: The troops crossed in a transport.
senses.exampleCN: 部队乘运输舰过海。
senses.why: A single carrier is just one instance of the carrying activity, so the noun names the craft too.
senses.whyCN: 一件运载工具只是搬运活动的一个实例，于是名词也用来指这种船或车。

senses.title: Strong emotion that carries one away
senses.definition: to carry someone away with joy, anger, or other feeling
senses.definitionCN: 让某人被喜悦或愤怒等情绪带走
senses.example: The music transported her back to childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐把她带回了童年。
senses.why: If the body can be carried across space, the mind can be carried across time and feeling.
senses.whyCN: 身体可以被搬过空间，心也可以被搬过时间与情感。

senses.title: To send someone away as punishment
senses.definition: to send a criminal to a distant place as a punishment
senses.definitionCN: 把罪犯送到远方作为惩罚
senses.example: Convicts were transported to the island.
senses.exampleCN: 囚犯被流放到那个岛上。
senses.why: The earliest English legal sense is being carried across the sea against one’s will.
senses.whyCN: 英语里最早的法律义项，就是被人强制运过大洋。

intro.en: The word is Latin trans-, across, plus portare, to carry, so it literally means carried across.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语 trans-（穿过）加 portare（搬运），字面就是「被搬过去」。

items.en: Portare means to carry or bear, and gives port, porter, and portable.
items.cn: 拉丁语 portare 意为搬运、承载，生出 port、porter、portable。

items.en: Transportare means to carry over or across, used of goods and of people.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transportare 意为运过去、搬过去，用于货物也用于人。

items.en: Old French transporter keeps the sense of carrying something over.
items.cn: 古法语 transporter 保留了把东西运过去的含义。

items.en: English uses the verb for moving goods, and from the seventeenth century for banishing convicts.
items.cn: 英语用这个动词指运货，十七世纪起又指流放囚犯。

items.en: Railways and motor traffic turn the noun into the name of a whole system of travel.
items.cn: 铁路与汽车交通使这个名词成为整套出行系统的名称。

note.en: The look-alike group shows other portare words and the trans- prefix, while the near-meaning group gathers words for carrying and shipping.
note.cn: 形近组列出其他 portare 词与 trans- 前缀，近义组汇集表示运送与航运的词。

normalIntro.en: Portare, to carry, is the heart of the word and of a large family.
normalIntro.cn: portare（搬运）是这个词的核心，也是一个大家族的根。

normal.en: Trans- is across, portare is carry, so transport is carry across.
normal.cn: trans- 是跨过，portare 是搬，所以 transport 就是搬过去。

normal.en: Porter is the person who carries, from the same root.
normal.cn: porter 是搬运的人，同出这个词根。

normal.en: Portable is the adjective for what can be carried.
normal.cn: portable 是可被搬走的形容词。

normal.en: Import and export add in and out to the same carrying root.
normal.cn: import 与 export 给同一个「搬」词根加上进与出。

normal.en: Transportation is the longer noun used more in American English.
normal.cn: transportation 是更长的名词，美式英语更常用。

abstract.en: Picture a convoy of lorries nose to tail on a night road.
abstract.cn: 想象夜间公路上首尾相接的车队。

abstract.en: Hear the boxes slide as each lorry takes a bend.
abstract.cn: 听见每个箱子在车转弯时滑动。

abstract.en: Then think of a mind carried away by a song, the same motion inside.
abstract.cn: 再想一颗心被歌声带走，是同一个动作。

examples.en: The company transports fresh fruit to three provinces.
examples.cn: 这家公司把新鲜水果运到三个省。

examples.en: Cheap public transport keeps the city moving.
examples.cn: 便宜的公共交通让城市运转不停。

examples.en: Prisoners were once transported to distant colonies.
examples.cn: 囚犯曾经被流放到遥远的殖民地。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯坡特」——东西一路穿过坡地运到特别远的地方。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the plain act of carrying to the emotion that carries a person away.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项从朴素的搬运，一路走到把人带走的情绪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: lorries nose to tail carrying crates across the country.
core.cn: 核心意象：首尾相接的货车把箱子运过整个国家。

branches.en: The plain act of carrying goods or people.
branches.cn: 最朴素的义项：搬货或载人。

branches.en: The system and the single vehicle, two ways of naming the carrying.
branches.cn: 体系与单件工具：命名搬运的两种方式。

branches.en: The emotional sense, where the mind is what gets carried.
branches.cn: 情感义：被搬走的是心。

branches.en: The legal sense, where a person is carried away by force.
branches.cn: 法律义：人被强制运走。

branches.en: The plain carrying sense, where crates are the load.
branches.cn: 朴素搬运义：箱子就是那担货。

intro.en: The word joins a Latin prefix of crossing to a Latin verb of carrying.
intro.cn: 这个词把表示跨越的拉丁前缀与拉丁语「搬运」动词连在一起。

latinIntro.en: Portare is behind a large family: port, porter, portable, import, export, and transport.
latinIntro.cn: portare 支撑着一个大家族：port、porter、portable、import、export 与 transport。

items.example: Transatlantic cables cross the ocean.
items.exampleCN: 跨大西洋电缆越过大洋。

items.example: The stem gives porter and portable.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干生出 porter 与 portable。

items.example: They transport coal by train.
items.exampleCN: 他们用火车运煤。

items.example: The country imports oil.
items.exampleCN: 这个国家进口石油。

items.example: They export tea to Europe.
items.exampleCN: 他们把茶叶出口到欧洲。

items.example: A portable radio fits in a bag.
items.exampleCN: 便携收音机能放进口袋。

items.example: The porter took our bags.
items.exampleCN: 搬运工拿走了我们的行李。

items.example: The beams support the roof.

definition_zh: 运输；运送；运输系统；交通工具；流放
definition_en: the act of moving people or goods, or the system of vehicles and routes that does it
core_image: 一张城市地图上，线密密麻麻地把码头、车站与仓库连成一张网
scene: 规划师摊开一张大地图，上面铁路、公路、航线交织成网，把港口与内陆的仓库都连了起来。The city spends heavily on transportation every year.
sceneCN: 这里 transportation 是「运输系统」（第 3 个义项：车辆与线路构成的体系）；句意为这座城市每年在交通上投入巨大。地图上的那张网就是本词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词后缀 -ation 还原为动词，义为「运输」
名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「运输的」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「运输者；运输车」

senses.title: The act of carrying things
senses.definition: the act or business of moving goods or people from place to place
senses.definitionCN: 把货物或人从一个地方运到另一个地方的行为或行业
senses.example: The transportation of coal by river is slow but cheap.
senses.exampleCN: 用河道运煤慢但便宜。
senses.why: Portare means to carry, so transportation names the carrying across places.
senses.whyCN: portare 意为搬运，所以 transportation 指跨地区的那一搬运。

senses.title: The vehicles that carry people
senses.definition: the vehicles, such as buses and trains, that carry people
senses.definitionCN: 公交车、火车这类载人的车辆
senses.example: She has no transportation of her own.
senses.exampleCN: 她没有自己的交通工具。
senses.why: The word can name the carriers themselves rather than the act, because they are what does the carrying.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也可以指承载者本身而非动作，因为干搬运活的就是它们。

senses.title: The whole system of moving
senses.definition: the organised system of roads, rails, and routes
senses.definitionCN: 由道路、铁路与航线组织起来的体系
senses.example: The city invests in green transportation.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市投资绿色交通。
senses.why: Once routes and vehicles are planned together, the whole network takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 当线路与车辆被一起规划，整张网络就承接了这个名字。

senses.title: Being moved from one place to another
senses.definition: the state of being carried somewhere, often to another country
senses.definitionCN: 被运到某处的状态，常指被运往他国
senses.example: The records were lost during their transportation.
senses.exampleCN: 这些档案在运送途中丢了。
senses.why: The passive side of carrying is also covered: it is what happens to the thing carried.
senses.whyCN: 搬运的被动一面也被涵盖：它是被搬之物所经历的事。

senses.title: Punishment by exile
senses.definition: the punishment of sending a criminal to a distant place
senses.definitionCN: 把罪犯送到远方的刑罚
senses.example: Transportation to the colonies ended in the nineteenth century.
senses.exampleCN: 向殖民地流放的刑罚在十九世纪终止。
senses.why: The harshest use of being carried away by force became a fixed name for a sentence.
senses.whyCN: 「被强制运走」最严厉的用法，固定成了刑罚的名称。

intro.en: The noun is transport plus -ation, built on Latin portare, to carry, and trans-, across.
intro.cn: 这个名词是 transport 加 -ation，建在拉丁语 portare（搬运）与 trans-（穿过）之上。

items.en: Portare means to carry, and supplies the -port- in transport, import, and export.
items.cn: 拉丁语 portare 意为搬运，提供 transport、import、export 中的 -port-。

items.en: Transportare means to carry over, and the noun transportatio names the carrying.
items.cn: 拉丁语 transportare 意为运过去，名词 transportatio 指这一搬运。

items.en: French transportation and the verb transporter pass the sense into English.
items.cn: 法语 transportation 与动词 transporter 把这一含义传入英语。

items.en: English uses the noun for the carrying of goods, and for penal exile abroad.
items.cn: 英语用这个名词指运货，也指流放海外。

items.en: In American English the long noun is the everyday word for the travel system.
items.cn: 在美式英语里，这个较长的名词就是日常说的「交通系统」。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the portare stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other words for moving goods.
note.cn: 形近组共用 portare 词干，近义组汇集搬运货物的其他说法。

abstract.en: Picture a map where every dot is joined by a coloured line.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，每个点都被彩色线连起来。

abstract.en: Feel the whole net hum with goods moving at night.
abstract.cn: 感受整张网在夜里嗡嗡运转。

abstract.en: Then see a single ship taking one person away for ever.
abstract.cn: 再看见一条船把一个人永远带走。

examples.en: The museum explains the history of penal transportation.
examples.cn: 博物馆讲解流放刑罚的历史。

definition_zh: 陷阱；圈套；捕捉；困住；使陷入困境
definition_en: a device or plan for catching something, or to catch and hold something so it cannot escape
core_image: 草丛里一块铺了落叶的木板，脚一踩便弹起铁夹
scene: 林子里，猎人在兽径上安了一块带机关的木板，上面盖了层落叶。A rabbit was caught in the trap before dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 trap 是「陷阱」（第 1 个义项：捕捉用的装置）；句意为天亮前一只兔子落进了陷阱。盖着落叶的木板与铁夹正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -er 构成，义为「设陷阱捕兽的人」
现在分词名词化，义为「捕捉；捕兽业」；复数指马饰
加前缀 en- 构成，义为「诱捕；使陷入」

senses.title: A device for catching animals
senses.definition: a device, often hidden, that catches and holds an animal
senses.definitionCN: 常被藏起来的装置，用来抓住并留住动物
senses.example: The farmer set traps for the rats.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫设了捕鼠夹。
senses.why: The word is an old English name for a snare, and its whole sense is a hidden catch that closes.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是古英语里对罗网的称呼，全部含义就是一道藏起来的、会合上的机关。

senses.title: A plan that deceives someone
senses.definition: a trick or plan that makes someone do what you want
senses.definitionCN: 诱使别人按你的意图行动的计谋
senses.example: The offer was a trap to get his signature.
senses.exampleCN: 那个提议是个骗他签字的圈套。
senses.why: A snare for an animal and a snare for a person share the same shape: a hidden catch.
senses.whyCN: 给动物设的套与给人的套形状相同：都是藏起来的机关。

senses.title: A bad situation one cannot leave
senses.definition: a difficult situation that is hard to escape from
senses.definitionCN: 难以脱身的艰难处境
senses.example: Debt can become a trap for young families.
senses.exampleCN: 债务可能成为年轻家庭的困境。
senses.why: When the catch is circumstances rather than jaws, the word still pictures something closing around a person.
senses.whyCN: 当合上的不是铁夹而是处境，这个词画的仍是有什么在人周围合拢。

senses.title: To catch and hold an animal
senses.definition: to catch an animal in a trap or by a similar means
senses.definitionCN: 用陷阱或类似办法抓住动物
senses.example: They trapped rabbits in the orchard.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在果园里捕兔。
senses.why: The verb is the action the noun describes: to close the catch on something.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是名词描述的那个动作：把机关合在某个东西上。

senses.title: To prevent from escaping
senses.definition: to hold people or things somewhere so they cannot move or leave
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物留在某处，使其动不了或走不了
senses.example: Rescuers freed the miners trapped underground.
senses.exampleCN: 救援人员救出了困在地下的矿工。
senses.why: Prisons and collapses both close a space around a person, which is the trap image without the jaws.
senses.whyCN: 监牢与塌方都在人身周围合拢一块空间，这正是去掉铁夹的陷阱画面。

senses.title: To hold heat or gas in place
senses.definition: to keep heat, gas, or light from escaping
senses.definitionCN: 不让热、气或光跑掉
senses.example: Thick walls trap warmth in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 厚墙在冬天能留住热量。
senses.why: A layer that does not let something out acts like a trap that does not let something in.
senses.whyCN: 一层不让东西出去的材料，就像一道不让东西进来的陷阱。

intro.en: The noun is an old English word for a snare, and the verb grows from it in the same period.
intro.cn: 这是古英语里表示罗网的名词，动词也在同一时期由它生出。

items.en: Treppe means a snare or trap, and is used of devices for catching wild animals.
items.cn: 古英语 treppe 意为罗网、陷阱，指捕捉野兽的装置。

items.en: The word has relatives in Dutch and Low German, all naming a catching device.
items.cn: 这个词在荷兰语与低地德语里都有亲族，都指捕捉装置。

items.en: The noun widens from animal snares to tricks that catch people.
items.cn: 中世纪英语里，这个名词从兽夹扩展到能套住人的计谋。

items.en: Railways and mining give the verb its sense of being shut in and unable to escape.
items.cn: 铁路与采矿给了动词「被困住、逃不掉」的义项。

items.en: Modern technology adds the sense of holding heat, gas, or light where it is wanted.
items.cn: 现代技术又添上「把热、气或光留在该留之处」的义项。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words that differ by one letter, while the near-meaning group names other snares and holds.
note.cn: 形近组汇集只差一个字母的短词，近义组列出其他圈套与困住的说法。

normalIntro.en: Four letters, but the image does all the work.
normalIntro.cn: 只有四个字母，但画面就能记住。

normal.en: Think of a trap door: the same short word sits in front.
normal.cn: 想想 trap door（活板门）：同一个短词就在前面。

normal.en: The verb doubles the p in the past: trapped.
normal.cn: 过去式双写 p：trapped。

normal.en: A trapper is the person, trapping is the work.
normal.cn: trapper 是人，trapping 是那份活。

normal.en: Entrap adds en- to make a verb of catching someone in a trick.
normal.cn: entrap 加 en-，成为「设计套人」的动词。

normal.en: A speed trap catches cars, not rabbits, with the same logic.
normal.cn: 测速陷阱抓的是车不是兔，逻辑却一样。

abstract.en: Picture leaves over a board, and the board springs up.
abstract.cn: 想象落叶盖着木板，木板一下弹起。

abstract.en: Hear the click before you see the jaws.
abstract.cn: 先听见那咔哒声，再看见铁夹。

abstract.en: Feel a space close around you, walls instead of jaws.
abstract.cn: 再感受空间在你周围合上，墙代替了铁夹。

examples.en: The mouse escaped the trap twice.
examples.cn: 那只老鼠两次逃出了捕鼠夹。

examples.en: They were trapped in the elevator for an hour.
examples.cn: 他们被困在电梯里一个小时。

examples.en: The glass traps heat from the winter sun.
examples.cn: 这种玻璃能留住冬日阳光的热量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「揣谱」——揣着谱子在林子里设套，一下就套住了。

root: 古英语 treppe（罗网、捕兽器），与荷兰语、低地德语同源；同族有 trapper、trapping、entrap

sensesIntro.en: The word always pictures something closing around a thing so that it cannot get out.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词总是画着「有什么在某物周围合上，让它出不来」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a board hidden under leaves, snapping shut.
core.cn: 核心意象：盖在落叶下的木板，一下合上。

branches.en: The physical pair: the device and the act of catching with it.
branches.cn: 实物一对：装置，以及用装置去抓的动作。

branches.en: The trick sense, where the snare is a plan aimed at a person.
branches.cn: 诡计义：罗网是针对人设的计划。

branches.en: The confinement senses, where circumstances take the place of jaws.
branches.cn: 困住义：处境取代了铁夹。

branches.en: The physical containment sense, where heat is what cannot get out.
branches.cn: 物理封存义：出不去的是热。

branches.en: The catching sense, where a hunter closes the jaws on a rabbit.
branches.cn: 捕捉义：猎人在兔子身上合上铁夹。

intro.en: This is a native word, so the pieces are suffixes rather than Latin roots.
intro.cn: 这是本族词，所以拆出来的是后缀而非拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: The stem trapp- appears in trapper, trapping, and the verb entrap.
latinIntro.cn: 词干 trapp- 出现在 trapper、trapping 与动词 entrap 里。

items.example: The stem is the whole of trap.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干就是 trap 的全部。

items.example: Trap gives trapper.
items.exampleCN: trap 加它成为 trapper。

items.example: Trap gives trapping.
items.exampleCN: trap 加它成为 trapping。

items.example: En- plus trap gives entrap.
items.exampleCN: en- 加 trap 成为 entrap。

items.example: They tried to entrap the witness.
items.exampleCN: 他们试图诱使证人落套。

items.example: The climbers were trapped by snow.
items.exampleCN: 登山者被雪困住。

items.example: Trapping was once common in the north.
items.exampleCN: 捕兽业曾在北方很常见。

items.meaning: loops of wire for catching birds
items.example: Old snares were loops, not jaws.
items.exampleCN: old snares 指套索，不是铁夹。

definition_zh: 对待；看待；治疗；招待；请客
definition_en: to behave towards someone in a certain way, to give medical care, or to pay for food for someone
core_image: 大人弯下腰，蹲到孩子眼睛的高度才开口说话
scene: 诊所里，医生对照片子一条条讲清病情，又叮嘱护士怎样照看。The doctor treated the burn with a cool dressing.
sceneCN: 这里 treat 是「治疗」（第 2 个义项：对病人施以医疗照顾）；句意为医生用冷敷处理了烫伤。先蹲下来与病人齐眼说话的画面，正是「对待」的本义。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ment 构成名词，义为「治疗；对待」
同根名词，义为「论著」
同根名词，义为「条约」

senses.title: To behave towards someone
senses.definition: to behave in a particular way towards a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式对待人或物
senses.example: She treats her students as equals.
senses.exampleCN: 她把学生当平等的人看待。
senses.why: The Latin tractare means to handle, and how you handle people is how you treat them.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 tractare 意为「处理、摆弄」，你怎么摆弄人，就是怎么对待人。

senses.title: To give medical care
senses.definition: to give medical care to a sick or injured person
senses.definitionCN: 对病人或伤者施以医疗
senses.example: The doctor treated him for a broken wrist.
senses.exampleCN: 医生给他治腕骨骨折。
senses.why: Medicine is a special kind of handling, so the same verb takes on the clinic.
senses.whyCN: 医疗是处理的一种特别方式，于是同一个动词走进了诊室。

senses.title: To deal with a substance
senses.definition: to apply a process to a material so that it changes
senses.definitionCN: 对材料施加某种工序使其改变
senses.example: The wood is treated against rot.
senses.exampleCN: 这木材经过防腐处理。
senses.why: Handling a material with a chemical is literally a handling, and the verb fits.
senses.whyCN: 用化学品去处理材料，字面上就是「摆弄」，动词正合适。

senses.title: To give food or fun at your cost
senses.definition: to buy food or entertainment for someone as a gift
senses.definitionCN: 花钱请别人吃东西或娱乐
senses.example: He treated us to lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 他请我们吃了午饭。
senses.why: Handling someone generously in a social setting becomes paying for them.
senses.whyCN: 在社交场合大方地「对付」某人，就变成了替他们付钱。

senses.title: A gift or pleasure given
senses.definition: something enjoyable given as a gift, or a special pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 作为礼物给人的享受，或特别的乐事
senses.example: The trip was a real treat.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行真是难得的乐事。
senses.why: The noun keeps the sense of something generously handled and then given.
senses.whyCN: 名词保留了「被大方地打理好然后送给人」的含义。

senses.title: To discuss or write about
senses.definition: to deal with a subject in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 以口头或书面方式讨论一个主题
senses.example: The book treats the subject briefly.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书对这个问题论述简略。
senses.why: Tractare also meant to discuss, the sense that survives in treatise and treaty.
senses.whyCN: tractare 也有「讨论」义，这层意思留在 treatise 与 treaty 里。

intro.en: The verb comes from Old French traitier, from Latin tractare, to handle or discuss.
intro.cn: 这个动词来自古法语 traitier，源头是拉丁语 tractare（处理、讨论）。

items.en: Trahere means to draw or pull, and tractare is its frequentative, to keep handling.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 意为拉，tractare 是它的反复形式，意为反复摆弄。

items.en: Traitier means to deal with a person, to negotiate, or to discuss a matter.
items.cn: 古法语 traitier 意为与人打交道、谈判或讨论某事。

items.en: English takes the verb for behaving towards people and for handling subjects.
items.cn: 英语借入这个动词，用于待人与论述主题。

items.en: Medicine turns handling into healing, and hospitality turns it into paying.
items.cn: 医学把「处理」变成治疗，好客把「处理」变成付钱。

items.en: The noun treat, a pleasure, appears much later than the verb.
items.cn: 名词 treat（乐事）比动词晚得多才出现。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tract- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other verbs of dealing with people or illness.
note.cn: 形近组共用 tract- 词干，近义组汇集表示待人、治病的其他动词。

normalIntro.en: Treat, treaty, treatise and treatment all grow from one Latin verb of handling.
normalIntro.cn: treat、treaty、treatise、treatment 都出自同一个表示「处理」的拉丁动词。

normal.en: Tractare is to handle, so treat is to handle a person, a wound, or a subject.
normal.cn: tractare 是处理，所以 treat 是处理一个人、一处伤或一个题目。

normal.en: Treatment is the noun: how someone or something is handled.
normal.cn: treatment 是名词：某人或某物被怎样处理。

normal.en: A treaty is a handling written down between states.
normal.cn: treaty 是国家之间写下来的「处理」。

normal.en: My treat means I pay, the handling made generous.
normal.cn: my treat 是我付钱，把「处理」变成了大方。

normal.en: The past is treated, and the door of the clinic uses the same word.
normal.cn: 过去式是 treated，诊所门上用的也是这个词。

abstract.en: Picture an adult bending to a child’s height before speaking.
abstract.cn: 想象大人弯到孩子的高度再开口。

abstract.en: The same bend is made over a wound, and over a hard material.
abstract.cn: 同一个弯腰，对着伤口，也对着硬材料。

abstract.en: Then see a hand reaching for the bill at dinner.
abstract.cn: 再看见饭后一只手去拿账单。

examples.en: They treated the old man with great respect.
examples.cn: 他们非常敬重这位老人。

examples.en: The nurse treated the cut and sent him home.
examples.cn: 护士处理了伤口就送他回家了。

examples.en: Let me treat you to a coffee.
examples.cn: 让我请你喝杯咖啡。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹特」——特别热情地吹一气，好好招待客人。

root: 拉丁语 trahere（拉）的反复形式 tractare（处理、讨论），经古法语 traitier 进入英语；同族有 treaty、treatment、treatise

sensesIntro.en: All senses are ways of handling something: a person, a wound, a material, a subject, or a bill.
sensesIntro.cn: 所有义项都是「处理」：处理一个人、一处伤、一种材料、一个题目，或一笔账。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an adult bending down to a child’s eye level.
core.cn: 核心意象：大人蹲到与孩子齐眼的高度。

branches.en: The social sense, how one person handles another.
branches.cn: 人际义：一个人怎样对待另一个人。

branches.en: The technical senses: handling a body or a material.
branches.cn: 技术义：处理身体或处理材料。

branches.en: The generous senses: paying, and the pleasure paid for.
branches.cn: 慷慨义：付钱，以及花钱买来的乐事。

branches.en: The written sense, kept alive in treatise and treaty.
branches.cn: 书面义：活在 treatise 与 treaty 里。

branches.en: The material sense, where timber is the thing handled.
branches.cn: 材料义：被处理的是木料。

intro.en: The verb is a worn-down Latin verb of handling, and its family is large.
intro.cn: 这个动词是磨圆了的拉丁语「处理」动词，词族很大。

latinIntro.en: The tract- stem appears in treat, treaty, treatment, tract, contract, and extract.
latinIntro.cn: tract- 词干出现在 treat、treaty、treatment、tract、contract 与 extract 里。

items.example: The stem gives tract and contract.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干生出 tract 与 contract。

items.meaning: to handle a person or thing
items.example: They treat guests warmly.
items.exampleCN: 他们热情待客。

items.example: Treat gives treatment.
items.exampleCN: treat 加它成为 treatment。

items.example: The treatment lasted six weeks.
items.exampleCN: 治疗持续了六周。

items.example: The treaty was signed in May.
items.exampleCN: 条约在五月签署。

items.meaning: a written handling of a subject
items.example: She wrote a treatise on bees.
items.exampleCN: 她写了一部论蜜蜂的著作。

items.example: He entreated her to wait.
items.exampleCN: 他恳求她等一等。

items.example: The army retreated at dusk.
items.exampleCN: 部队黄昏撤退。

items.example: They extract oil from seeds.
items.exampleCN: 他们从种子里榨油。

definition_zh: 治疗；疗法；对待；处理；处理方式
definition_en: the care given to cure an illness or injury, or the way a person or thing is dealt with
core_image: 病床边挂着输液袋，护士按表一格一格记录换药
scene: 住院部的床头挂着卡片，护士按上面的疗程逐日换药记录。The new treatment reduced the pain within a week.
sceneCN: 这里 treatment 是「治疗、疗法」（第 1 个义项：为治愈而给的医疗照护）；句意为新疗法一周内就减轻了疼痛。床头那张逐日记录的卡片正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀 -ment 还原为动词，义为「对待；治疗」
由 treat 加 -able 构成，义为「可治疗的」
加前缀 mis- 构成，义为「虐待」

senses.title: Medical care for an illness
senses.definition: the care and medicine given to cure a disease or injury
senses.definitionCN: 为治愈疾病或伤处而给的照护与药物
senses.example: She is receiving treatment for the infection.
senses.exampleCN: 她正在接受感染治疗。
senses.why: Treating a patient is handling the body back to health, and the noun names that handling.
senses.whyCN: 治疗病人就是把身体料理回健康，名词指的就是这份料理。

senses.title: A particular method of healing
senses.definition: a specific way of treating a disease
senses.definitionCN: 治疗某种病的具体办法
senses.example: The clinic offers two treatments for the knee.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所对膝关节有两种疗法。
senses.why: Once methods are compared, the noun shifts from care in general to one named method.
senses.whyCN: 一旦比较各种方法，名词就从笼统的照护转向某一种有名字的疗法。

senses.title: The way a person is dealt with
senses.definition: the way someone is behaved towards
senses.definitionCN: 别人对待某人的方式
senses.example: The workers asked for fair treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们要求公平对待。
senses.why: The oldest sense of treat is to behave towards, so treatment is simply how that behaves out.
senses.whyCN: treat 最老的含义就是「朝向某人的行为」，treatment 就是把这种行为表现出的样子。

senses.title: A process applied to a material
senses.definition: a process that is applied to a substance to change it
senses.definitionCN: 为使物质改变而施加的工序
senses.example: The water needs chemical treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 这水需要化学处理。
senses.why: Handling a material is the same handling as handling a person, only without feeling.
senses.whyCN: 处理材料与待人同属「处理」，只是对象没有感情。

senses.title: A way of presenting a subject
senses.definition: the way a writer or artist deals with a subject
senses.definitionCN: 作者或艺术家处理题材的方式
senses.example: Her treatment of the war is very restrained.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这场战争的处理很克制。
senses.why: Tractare also meant to discuss, so how a subject is discussed is its treatment.
senses.whyCN: tractare 也有讨论义，所以一个题目被怎样讨论，就是它的「处理方式」。

intro.en: The noun is treat plus -ment, and treat comes from Latin tractare, to handle.
intro.cn: 这个名词是 treat 加 -ment，而 treat 出自拉丁语 tractare（处理）。

items.en: Tractare is the frequentative of trahere, to draw, and means to keep handling.
items.cn: tractare 是 trahere（拉）的反复形式，意为反复摆弄。

items.en: Traitier gives the English verb treat, for dealing with people and matters.
items.cn: 古法语 traitier 生出英语动词 treat，用于待人与处事。

items.en: The -ment ending turns the verb into a noun of the handling itself.
items.cn: -ment 词尾把动词变成表示「处理本身」的名词。

items.en: Medicine makes the medical sense the dominant one in modern use.
items.cn: 现代用法中，医学义成了最主要的义项。

items.en: Industry and journalism extend it to water, waste, and the handling of subjects.
items.cn: 工业与新闻业把它扩展到水、废物与题材的处理上。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the treat- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other words for care and handling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 treat- 词干，近义组汇集表示照护与处理的其他说法。

normalIntro.en: Treat plus -ment: the verb known, the noun follows.
normalIntro.cn: 在 treat 后加上 -ment，动词认识了，名词就跟着来。

normal.en: Treat is to handle, and -ment makes that handling into a thing.
normal.cn: treat 是处理，-ment 把这份处理变成一样东西。

normal.en: Treatment in a hospital is handling a body back to health.
normal.cn: 医院里的 treatment 是把身体料理回健康。

normal.en: Mistreatment adds mis-, meaning handling the wrong way.
normal.cn: mistreatment 加 mis-，意为用错方式对待。

normal.en: Water treatment plants handle water, not patients.
normal.cn: 水处理厂处理的是水，不是病人。

normal.en: The word appears in headlines about fair and unfair handling alike.
normal.cn: 这个词既见于公平对待的标题，也见于不公对待的标题。

abstract.en: Picture a card at the head of a hospital bed, ticked each day.
abstract.cn: 想象床头一张卡片，每天打一个勾。

abstract.en: Hear the drip counted in drops.
abstract.cn: 听输液一滴一滴地数。

abstract.en: Then move the same careful tick to a water tank and to a worker’s pay.
abstract.cn: 再把同样的仔细勾画挪到水池与工人的工资上。

examples.en: He began treatment for the disease last spring.
examples.cn: 他去年春天开始接受该病的治疗。

examples.en: The staff received training in the fair treatment of patients.
examples.cn: 员工接受了公平对待病人的培训。

examples.en: The plant provides treatment for waste water.
examples.cn: 这座工厂负责废水的处理。

sensesIntro.en: The word covers handling of every kind, with healing as the most familiar branch.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词涵盖各种各样的「处理」，其中以治疗最为人熟悉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a card at a hospital bed, ticked once each day.

branches.en: The fairness sense, how people behave towards people.

branches.en: The industrial sense, where a material is the patient.

intro.en: The noun adds a Latin suffix to a French verb of handling.

latinIntro.en: The tract- stem runs through treat, treatment, treaty, contract, and extract.
latinIntro.cn: tract- 词干贯穿 treat、treatment、treaty、contract 与 extract。

items.example: The stem gives contract and extract.

items.example: They treat the staff well.

items.exampleCN: mis- 加 treat 成为 mistreat。

items.example: The case involved mistreatment.

items.meaning: the way something is dealt with

definition_zh: 条约；协议；协定
definition_en: a formal written agreement between two or more countries, signed by their governments
core_image: 长桌两端两位代表同时落笔，纸页上并排着两种文字的签名
scene: 大厅里两张长桌拼在一起，两国的代表各自翻开文件夹。The two countries signed a peace treaty after a year of talks.
sceneCN: 这里 treaty 是「条约」（第 1 个义项：两国或多国政府签署的正式书面协议）；句意为经过一年谈判，两国签署了和平条约。长桌上并排的两份签名，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: treaty 的词源动词，义为「对待；谈判」
由 treat 加 -ment 构成，义为「对待；处理」
与 treaty 同源的词，义为「论文；专著」

senses.title: The signed paper
senses.definition: a formal agreement between states, written down and signed by those in power
senses.definitionCN: 国家之间写下并由掌权者签署的正式协议
senses.example: The two countries signed a peace treaty after a year of talks.
senses.exampleCN: 经过一年谈判，两国签署了和平条约。
senses.why: Medieval Latin tractatus meant a handling or a discussion, and a treaty is the paper produced when talks end.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语 tractatus 意为处理或讨论，treaty 就是讨论结束后产生的那份文书。

senses.title: A deal between groups
senses.definition: an agreement of the same kind made by other large bodies such as companies
senses.definitionCN: 公司等大型机构之间订立的同类协议
senses.example: The two firms signed a treaty on sharing the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司就共用港口签署了一份协议。
senses.why: The word began to travel from governments to any body large enough to act like one.
senses.whyCN: 这个词开始从政府延伸到任何大到能像政府一样行动的机构。

intro.en: Treaty comes from the Latin verb tractare, to handle or discuss, through the noun tractatus, a discussion.
intro.cn: treaty 经由名词 tractatus（讨论）来自拉丁语动词 tractare（处理、商谈）。

items.en: Tractare meant to drag, handle, and later to discuss or negotiate.
items.cn: tractare 意为拖动、处理，后来指讨论与商谈。

items.en: Tractatus named a treatment or a written discussion of a subject.
items.cn: tractatus 指一次处理，或对某主题的书面论述。

items.en: French made traitie, a discussion that ends in an agreement.
items.cn: 法语造出 traitie，指以协议告终的商讨。

items.en: English treaty first meant any negotiation between rulers.
items.cn: 中古英语的 treaty 最初指统治者之间的任何谈判。

items.en: By the modern period the word meant the signed document itself.
items.cn: 到了近代，这个词指已签署的文件本身。

note.en: The first group shares the tract stem, the second holds other words for formal agreements.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tract 词干，第二组收其他表示正式协定的词。

entries.definition: To behave toward someone or to give medical care.
The way a person or thing is handled.
A long written work on a subject.
An arrangement accepted by both sides.
A firm promise between parties.
A formal settlement between states.

normalIntro.en: Treaty hides the same root as treat: talks that end in a treaty are talks that have been handled to a finish.
normalIntro.cn: treaty 藏着与 treat 相同的词根：以条约结束的谈判，就是把事情处理到底的商谈。

normal.en: The plural changes y to ies: treaties.
normal.cn: 复数把 y 变 ies：treaties。

normal.en: The word begins with treat, the everyday verb.
normal.cn: 这个词以日常动词 treat 开头。

normal.en: A peace treaty is the most common phrase of all.
normal.cn: peace treaty 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: TREAty.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：TREAty。

normal.en: A treaty is signed, broken, or kept, like a promise on paper.
normal.cn: 条约和纸上的承诺一样，会被签署、违反或遵守。

abstract.en: Two pens meeting on the same line.
abstract.cn: 两支笔落在同一条线上。

abstract.en: A page with two languages and two seals.
abstract.cn: 一张写着两种语言、盖着两枚印章的纸。

abstract.en: The silence after the last signature.
abstract.cn: 最后一个签名之后的那份安静。

examples.en: Both sides hope to reach a treaty before the winter.
examples.cn: 双方希望在入冬前达成一项条约。

examples.en: The old treaty fixed the border along the river.
examples.cn: 旧条约以河流划定边界。

examples.en: They met to discuss a trade agreement between the neighbours.
examples.cn: 他们开会讨论邻国之间的贸易协定。

dict_mnemonic.text: treat（商谈处理）＋ y——商谈到底后签下的那张纸，就是条约。

root: 经由古法语 traitie 来自拉丁语 tractatus（处理、讨论），词根 tract- 意为「拉、处理」；同源词有 treat、treatment、treatise。

sensesIntro.en: First the signed document between states, then the same kind of deal between large bodies.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是国家之间签署的文件，再是大型机构之间的同类协议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two pens landing on the same line.
core.cn: 核心意象：两支笔落在同一行上。

branches.en: The state branch: an agreement between governments.
branches.cn: 国家分支：政府之间的协议。

branches.en: The body branch: a deal between large groups.
branches.cn: 机构分支：大集团之间的协议。

branches.en: The paper branch: both end in a signed document.
branches.cn: 文书分支：两者都以签署的文件告终。

branches.en: The border branch: treaties draw lines on maps.
branches.cn: 边界分支：条约在地图上画线。

branches.en: The talk branch: all of it begins as discussion.
branches.cn: 商谈分支：一切从讨论开始。

intro.en: Treaty is built on the Latin stem tract, drawn or handled, with an Old French noun ending on top.
intro.cn: treaty 建在拉丁词干 tract（拉、处理）之上，外面套着古法语的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere, to pull, gives the family of tract, treat, and treaty, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere（拉）生出 tract、treat 与 treaty 这一词族，列在下面。

items.example: The root links pulling and dealing with people.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根把「拉」与「应对人」连在一起。

items.example: It turns the handling into a document.
items.exampleCN: 它把处理的过程变成一份文件。

items.meaning: to behave toward, to deal with
items.example: The verb keeps the plain sense of handling.
items.exampleCN: 动词保留处理的朴素含义。

items.example: The noun names the finished paper.
items.exampleCN: 名词指完成的文书。

items.example: Ment marks the manner of handling.
items.exampleCN: ment 标记处理的方式。

items.example: A treatise handles a subject on paper.
items.exampleCN: treatise 在纸上处理一个主题。

items.example: Here the root pulls in a literal sense.
items.exampleCN: 这里词根是字面意义上的拉。

items.example: Ad means toward, so things are pulled near.
items.exampleCN: ad 意为朝向，于是把东西拉近。
